title: PhD Position in Large-Signal Modelling and Transient Stability Analysis of Wind Turbine Generators under Grid Fault Conditions
description:
The WindConnect (wind farm control and integration in sector-coupled power systems https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101227683) consortium unites leading experts from academia and industry across Europe, leveraging expertise in wind energy, power systems, power electronics, control engineering, artificial intelligence, and energy economics. This multidisciplinary collaboration addresses the pressing challenges of integrating wind energy into sector-coupled power systems including green hydrogen production, while ensuring grid stability, flexibility, and sustainability.

At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The PhD stipend is open for appointments from 1st March 2027 or soon after. The position is for 3 years, and it is funded by the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Networks programme under the WindConnect project.

  • On the date of recruitment (expected to be 1 March 2027), applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately preceding the recruitment date. Applicants must not hold a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment.
  • The project offers you competitive salaries (plus allowances) and funding for technical and personal skills training and participation in international research events.
  • You will participate in international secondments to other organisations in the network.

AAU Energy is a dynamic engineering research department in continuous growth and inspiring surroundings. AAU Energy has a very international environment and covers all areas of clean and sustainable energy systems of the future within electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technology. AAU Energy has campuses in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, this position is located in Aalborg.

The mission is to be world leading in both research and research-based education of the energy engineers of the future. AAU Energy has approx. 300 employees of many nationalities, of which 25 are administrative staff. In addition, AAU Energy constantly has approx. 50-70 guest researchers from around the world.

Research and teaching are in the absolute world elite in the field of energy, and we have extensive and leading workshop and laboratory facilities, where research and innovation are carried out in direct collaboration with industry to a great extent.

The position is offered in relation to the research program "Power Electronic Control Reliability and System Optimization" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems”.

The increasing integration of wind turbine generators significantly alters power system dynamics, particularly under grid fault conditions. While grid-forming (GFM) wind turbine generators contribute to voltage and frequency regulation, they may exhibit significant nonlinear large-signal behaviour during disturbances, including current limiting, control mode switching, and loss of synchronism. In multi-converter systems, these transient dynamics are further shaped by interactions among multiple GFM units and the surrounding grid strength. Conventional small-signal models are therefore inadequate, motivating large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis frameworks for GFM wind turbine generators under grid faults.

This poses the following key research questions:

  • How can large-signal models of GFM wind turbine generators be developed to accurately capture nonlinear dynamics, particularly current limiting and control mode transitions during grid faults?
  • How do multiple wind turbine generators interact during grid faults, and how do grid strength and system configurations influence their transient stability?
  • What are the dominant dynamic mechanisms governing transient stability, and how can reduced-order models be developed while preserving the essential nonlinear dynamics and stability characteristics?

This project will be in close collaboration with Ørsted. The PhD student is expected to work closely with colleagues from Ørsted and visit their facilities. The aim of this PhD project is to develop large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis methods for wind turbine generators under grid fault conditions, with particular emphasis on multi-inverter systems. The project seeks to identify key mechanisms affecting transient stability and to provide modelling and analysis tools that support robust control and protection design for future wind-dominated power systems.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (3-5 pages), which describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives. All documentation should be in English and merged in a single PDF document. Please note that applications which do not follow the announcement’s guidelines will not be considered.
  • Other relevant documents

Applicants should have an excellent academic background and hold a master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field. Knowledge or experience in power electronic converters and their control will be an advantage. Applicants who are in the final stage of their master’s studies are also encouraged to apply, provided that they complete their degree before the fellowship begins.

  • Strong motivation and potential for academic research, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. Creativity, initiative, and an open-minded approach to research are highly valued.
  • Knowledge or experience in modelling, control and stability analysis of grid-connected power electronic converters, particularly GFM converters, and power system stability analysis will be an advantage.
  • Experience with simulation and programming tools, such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, or equivalent platforms, will be an advantage.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Publications in international peer-reviewed journals or conferences will be considered an advantage.

title: Treasury Analyst, Markets & Analytics
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Do you want to work in an international investment fund promoting economic and social progress through commercial investments?

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s largest impact fund and is internationally recognized as a best-in-class impact investor. We manage our own private equity funds, debt capital, and concessional capital with a focus on creating sustainable businesses that deliver measurable social, economic and climate impact alongside solid financial returns.

 

About the role

We are looking for a Treasury Analyst to join our Treasury team. The role sits at the intersection of financial markets, quantitative analysis, trading and technology. You will support treasury decision-making, execute and analyse financial transactions, develop and use the tools and data infrastructure used by the Treasury function.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Negotiate, execute and support FX, money-market, interest-rate and derivative transactions, including swaps and hedging activities.

  • Perform quantitative analysis of FX, interest-rate and liquidity risk via statistics and scenario analyses.

  • Develop models for cash-flow forecasting, liquidity management, pricing and risk/position management.

  • Develop and maintain Treasury analytics and reporting using SQL, Python, Power BI and/or Excel/VBA.

  • Extract, structure and analyse data from Treasury Risk/Position Systems, Investment Management Systems, ERP systems and market-data platforms.

  • Automate Treasury processes and controls and contribute to improvements in the Treasury IT architecture.

  • Support and pursue implementation and valuation of new financial products.

  • Monitor financial markets and provide analysis supporting funding, investment and hedging decisions.

 

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science or similar.

  • Initial relevant work experience, for example 1–3 years' experience from a student job or up to 2 years full-time experience after graduation within Treasury, trading, financial markets and quantitative finance.

  • Practical experience with FX, interest rates, derivatives and/or money-market instruments.

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.

  • Experience with SQL and ideally Python, VBA or similar programming languages.

  • Understanding of databases, APIs, data structures and financial systems.

  • Experience with Treasury Management Systems, ERP systems, Investment Management Systems and market-data platforms is an advantage. Especially Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Microsoft Dynamics platform/data structure and Bloomberg.

  • Ability to translate complex financial requirements into robust analytical and IT solutions.

  • Proficiency in English is required, while spoken Danish is an advantage.

title: PhD in modelling and experiments on PEM electrolysis
description:
At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from January 1st or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks    The position is offered in relation to the research group "Hydrogen and Electro Fuels" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Thermal Engineering”.

Your competencies As a PhD student in modelling and experiments on PEM water electrolysis, you will work at the intersection of chemical and electrochemical reactor engineering, with a particular emphasis on electrolysis. The project focuses on testing proton exchange membrane electrolysis cells, characterising their electrochemical performance and developing detailed electrochemical cell models. You will design and carry out experiments on single cells, analyse electrochemical behaviour under different operating conditions and use the resulting data to build, calibrate and validate mechanistic models that describe transport, kinetics and degradation phenomena.

An important part of your work will be to investigate how PEM electrolysers perform when conventional materials are partially replaced by recycled ionomers and iridium. You will compare performance, stability and degradation patterns with and without recycled components and translate your findings into a deeper understanding of the underlying electrochemical mechanisms. In parallel, you will conduct techno‑economic assessments of PEM electrolysis systems, including related life cycle assessment studies, to evaluate how material choices, operating strategies and system design affect costs and environmental impacts over the full life cycle.

The PhD project is carried out in the context of the CYCLOPEM, EDSOES and CAPEX projects, which provide access to state‑of‑the‑art experimental facilities and collaboration with academic and industrial partners. You are expected to participate in project meetings and to present your results at international conferences and workshops. In addition, you will contribute to teaching activities within courses on chemical and electrochemical reactors and take part in the daily activities of the Hydrogen and Electro Fuels research group  at AAU Energy, including group meetings, seminars and joint publications.

The applicant must have a relevant professional and/or educational background within thermal, chemical and electrochemical engineering. Modelling of chemical and electrochemical reactor and LCA.Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of cleanand sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real‑world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg/Esbjerg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dkHow to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (4-5 pages), that: describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

title: Product Owner - Shape the Future of Industrial Ice Cream Filling
description:
At Gram Equipment, we develop the technology behind ice cream products enjoyed by people around the world.

As a global provider of equipment and complete production solutions for the ice cream industry, we combine more than a century of experience with innovation, technical expertise and close customer collaboration. Our filling solutions help customers produce cups, cones, tubs and other filled products efficiently, reliably and at high quality.

We are now looking for a Product Owner to help develop and strengthen our filling product portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.

Your Role

As Product Owner – Flexline, you will take technical ownership of our filling product portfolio and play a central role in its continued development.

You will connect customer requirements, market opportunities and operational experience with engineering and product development. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Automation, Sales, Projects, Production and Service, you will ensure that our filling solutions remain competitive, reliable and aligned with customer needs.

You will maintain the product roadmap, prioritize improvements and support projects throughout the value chain—from quotation and technical clarification to production, commissioning and lifecycle support.

Technical and Cross-Functional Execution
  • Support project reviews, design approvals, technical clarifications and decisions concerning product interfaces.
  • Ensure that project-specific solutions remain aligned with product standards, technical feasibility, safety, cost and delivery requirements.
  • Coordinate closely with mechanical engineering, automation, production, assembly and project management.

Commercial and Customer Support

  • Opportunities for professional development and increasing product responsibility.
  • An informal and collaborative workplace where knowledge sharing and practical improvement are valued.
  • Competitive employment conditions aligned with your experience and qualifications.

The position is based at our headquarters in Kolding, Denmark. You should expect approximately 0–30 travel days per year, primarily for customer meetings, technical clarification, commissioning support and product validation.

Apply Now

Would you like to take ownership of filling technology and help turn customer needs, market insight and engineering expertise into competitive product solutions?

Join Gram Equipment and help shape the next generation of industrial ice cream filling equipment.

title: 2 Assistant Professor Positions (non-tenured) with a Focus on Innovation in Pharmacy or Medicinal Chemistry at SDU in Odense
description:
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for 2 positions as Assistant Professor with a focus on innovation within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

The positions are expected to commence on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. Each position is fixed-term for 3 years.

The positions are intended for talented early-career researchers who wish to develop an independent academic profile at the intersection of research, innovation and education. The successful candidates will conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry and contribute to translating scientific knowledge into solutions with potential value for patients, healthcare, society or the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science and is located at SDU’s main campus in Odense. The department is responsible for educational programmes in chemistry, medicinal chemistry and physics, as well as the bachelor’s programme in pharmacy. The successful candidates will join the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and become part of an interdisciplinary research environment with strong opportunities for collaboration across scientific fields and with external partners.

 

Research and innovation profile

The assistant professors will develop and conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear focus on innovation and application. Relevant research may include, but is not limited to, the discovery, design, development, formulation, delivery, analysis or evaluation of pharmaceutical substances, technologies and products. Innovation is understood broadly and may involve the development or application of new:

  • compounds, drug candidates or therapeutic concepts;

  • formulations, drug-delivery systems or pharmaceutical products;

  • experimental, analytical, computational or data-driven methods;

  • technologies, platforms, processes or research tools;

  • approaches to solving challenges relevant to patients, healthcare, society or industry.

The successful candidates are expected to identify the innovation potential of their research and contribute to its maturation and translation. Depending on the nature and stage of the research, this may include validation of concepts, development of prototypes or proof of concept, collaboration with relevant users and external partners, protection of intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or other pathways to application and impact.

The positions provide an opportunity for early-career researchers to develop an independent research and innovation profile. Applicants are therefore not expected to have an extensive record of patents, commercialization or entrepreneurship. Relevant previous experience is an advantage, but equal emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s scientific qualifications, motivation and potential to develop innovative research.

 

Roles and responsibilities

The assistant professors will be expected to:

  • Establish and develop an independent research programme within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear innovation perspective.

  • Conduct high-quality research and communicate the results through scientific publications, conferences and relevant outreach activities.

  • Identify and explore the scientific, societal and/or commercial potential of research ideas and results.

  • Develop research-based concepts, methods, technologies or solutions towards validation, proof of concept or application, where relevant.

  • Establish collaborations across disciplines and engage with relevant academic and external partners, such as companies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, public authorities, innovation environments or other users.

  • Apply for or contribute to applications for external research and innovation funding.

  • Contribute to teaching and course development within the department’s educational programmes, particularly pharmacy, medicinal chemistry and related areas.

  • Contribute to research-based and innovation-oriented teaching, including the involvement of students in relevant research and innovation activities.

  • Supervise and mentor bachelor’s and master’s students and, where relevant, contribute to the supervision of PhD students and other junior researchers.

  • Participate actively in the academic environment and contribute to the continued development of the department’s research, innovation and educational activities.

  • Participate in public engagement, knowledge exchange and other activities that strengthen the relationship between the university and the surrounding society.

 

The ideal candidate

We seek ambitious and collaborative early-career researchers with:

  • A PhD degree in pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or another closely related field.

  • A strong scientific background relevant to research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

  • The ability and motivation to develop an independent research and innovation profile.

  • A clear interest in translating scientific knowledge into new concepts, methods, technologies, products, practices or other solutions.

  • The potential to identify relevant needs and opportunities and engage with academic and external partners.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research.

  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.

 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not a requirement:

  • Translational or application-oriented research.

  • Interdisciplinary collaboration.

  • Collaboration with industry, hospitals, healthcare organizations, public authorities or other external partners.

  • Development and validation of methods, technologies, prototypes or proof-of-concept studies.

  • Intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or commercialization.

  • Participation in applications for research or innovation funding.

  • Innovation-oriented teaching or student activities.

As the positions are aimed at early-career researchers, applicants will be assessed in relation to their career stage. Applicants are not required to demonstrate an established innovation track record. A convincing motivation and a realistic plan for developing innovative research will be central to the assessment.

 

The research and innovation environment

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy provides a highly collaborative environment that brings together experimental, computational and theoretical research. The department offers broad opportunities for collaboration within research, innovation, funding applications and teaching.

The successful candidates will become part of the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and will have opportunities to collaborate with researchers across the department, the Faculty of Science, other faculties at SDU and relevant external organizations.

SDU provides access to an extensive innovation ecosystem that supports researchers in developing ideas and exploring pathways towards application and impact. Depending on the individual project, this may include support for innovation funding, collaboration with external partners, intellectual property, technology maturation, entrepreneurship and business development.

The assistant professors will be expected to contribute actively to this environment and to help strengthen connections between excellent research, education, innovation and society.

 

What we offer

The successful candidates will be offered:

  • The opportunity to establish an independent research and innovation profile in a supportive academic environment.

  • Access to interdisciplinary research communities and relevant experimental, analytical and computational infrastructure.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with academic and external partners.

  • Support for the development of applications for research and innovation funding.

  • Access to relevant mentoring, career-development and pedagogical activities.

  • Opportunities to contribute to the further development of innovation within the department’s research and educational programmes.

title: Teamspective: Account Executive (Denmark or Sweden)
description: **Type:** Full-time, permanent**Location:** Helsinki, Copenhagen, Stockholm**Application deadline:** Tue 1.12.2026Join Teamspective, a fast-growing Finnish AI-native SaaS company transforming how organizations lead their people. Our AI-native platform turns employee insights into practical guidance for leaders routines, helping managers lead better every day. With strong growth, proven customer success across the Nordics, and ambitious international plans, we're now ready to accelerate our expansion into Denmark and Sweden.As our **Account Executive for Denmark**, you'll build on our existing customer relationships and strong references, including **Danfoss**, to expand Teamspective's presence in the Danish market. As our **Account Executive for Sweden**, youll focus on opening new opportunities and growing our customer base in a market where were already working with companies like **Hitta.se**. In either role, you'll take ownership of your market and help shape how Teamspective grows internationally.**Your key responsibilities will include:**- Owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pipeline building to closing deals, with a focus on mid-sized and large organizations. - Leading discovery meetings and product demos to uncover customer needs and demonstrate Teamspective's value. - Driving B2B sales processes from initial contact to negotiations, procurement, and closing. - Building trusted relationships with HR leaders and other decision-makers through consultative selling. - Developing your market approach and identifying opportunities to scale Teamspective's presence in your country. You'll work closely with our CRO and CEO, existing sales team, and colleagues in customer success and product development, giving you direct access to commercial leadership and the expertise behind our product.Looking further ahead, as Teamspective's presence in your market grows, you could have the opportunity to step into a Country Manager role and build and lead your own local sales team.**Who we're looking for**You're a commercially driven, hands-on sales professional who enjoys opening doors, building relationships, and turning opportunities into results. You know how to engage HR decision-makers and understand what drives their business. You bring strong Danish or Swedish language skills and an understanding of your respective market. Above all, you thrive on taking ownership and are excited to build and grow a market over the long term.**What we expect from you:**- At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably SaaS, technology, or HR-related - Experience in solution sales to a clearly defined B2B customer segment, with the ability to understand customer challenges and demonstrate business value - A proven track record in new business acquisition and managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals - A proactive, independent approach to sales and the drive to build your own pipeline and develop a market - Excellent Danish skills for the Denmark position, or excellent Swedish skills for the Sweden position, alongside good English skills **What we consider a plus:**- Experience selling HR technology solutions or other B2B solutions to HR decision-makers, with an understanding of their business challenges - An established network of HR leaders and decision-makers in Denmark or Sweden - Previous experience opening new markets or developing sales operations in an international growth company **What we offer you:**- Build your market and shape the go-to-market strategy with real ownership. - Sell an AI-native solution that helps organizations turn better leadership into a competitive advantage. - Work alongside experienced leaders and a tight-knit team that moves fast and has your back. - Drive international growth with a proven product, strong customer references, and room to make your mark. - Grow toward a potential Country Manager role and eventually build and lead your own local team. **Practicalities:**These are full-time, permanent positions in which you will be employed directly by Teamspective. You can be based in Helsinki or your respective target market, Copenhagen or Stockholm, after the initial onboarding period. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible in early 2027.**Onboarding:**The role requires you to spend your first 3–6 months working in Helsinki. During this period, you will work closely with Teamspective's commercial, customer success, and product teams, build a deep understanding of the product, and start developing your market from day one. Teamspective will cover accommodation in Helsinki for candidates relocating temporarily. After onboarding, you can work from Helsinki or your respective target country, with regular visits to Helsinki.**Compensation:**The base salary in this position starts from 4000 €/month, complemented by an uncapped commission. As an indicative estimate, on-target earnings (OTE) could range from 90-110 000 euros annually, depending on sales performance. The commission model also includes incentives for qualified meetings during the probationary period. You'll also join Teamspective's employee stock option program after your probationary period. As you grow into a Sales Manager or Country Manager role, there may be opportunities to negotiate a larger equity stake.**Ready to build success in a new market?**Please submit your CV and brief motivation statement by the latest Tue 1st of December 2026 via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/396854/create/.Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. title: Gårdtrækker, 34 timer / Yard driver, 34 hours per week
description:
Vi søger lige nu en Gårdtrækker til REMA Distribution A/S på Hjulmagervej 12 i Vejle

Som medarbejder hos REMA Distribution bliver du del af en virksomhed, der vil være bedst til at drive dagligvarebutik i Danmark – med fokus på kvalitet til lave priser. Du får en central rolle i denne proces og bliver en del af vores gårdtrækkerteam fuld af dygtige og kompetente kolleger i Vejle.

Om jobbetMed reference til Driftschefen indgår du i vores team af medarbejdere, som arbejder tæt sammen med vores lager og logistikafdeling.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver:

  • Kørsel med Gårdtrækker på terminalområdet

  • Til- og frakobling af trailere

  • Klargøring til læsning og losning

  • Truckkørsel og intern transport

  • Læsning, losning og håndtering af gods

  • Lager- og terminalopgaver efter behov

  • Rengøring af Terberg.

Vores lager sørger for, at traileren er læsset og klar, inden den skal fjernes. Du får et selvstændigt og udfordrende fuldtidsjob med løn iflg. overenskomst, pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring.

Du vil skulle arbejde i et 3-ugers rul. Arbejdstiden er om eftermiddagen og skifter i tidsrummet ml. kl. 10.00 og kl. 23.00. Der må påregnes overarbejde i travle perioder.

Dine faglige kvalifikationer

  • Du har kørekort til C/E, chaufføruddannelsesbevis, førerkort og truckcertifikat

  • Du har erfaring fra en lignende stilling

  • Du taler og skriver dansk og/eller engelsk

Dine personlige kvalifikationer

Du er som person selvstændig, serviceminded og sætter en ære i at gøre tingene ordentligt. Som medarbejder og kollega er du fleksibel på arbejdstiden, mødestabil og imødekommende. Du arbejder effektivt uden at miste fokus på sikkerheden, og du har lyst til at give vores kunder en god oplevelse, hvor end du kommer.

Om REMA 1000

I REMA 1000 er vi mere end 17.500 entusiastiske mennesker med ét fælles mål: Vi vil være bedst til at drive dagligvarebutik i Danmark – med fokus på kvalitet til lave priser. Det absolut vigtigste element i den mission er engagerede og virkelystne mennesker, som elsker at gøre en forskel i deres job.

Vi har i dag flere end 440 butikker, og butikkerne er drevet efter en franchisemodel med selvstændige, lokalkendte købmænd i spidsen for den enkelte butik.

I Baglandet hos REMA 1000 / REMA Distribution er vi mere end 1.300 medarbejdere, som skaber konkurrencekraft, servicerer og leverer varer til REMA 1000 butikkerne og andre kæder indenfor dagligvare- og convenience branchen.

Lyder det som noget for dig?Så send os en ansøgning til Drifschef Brian Schmidt på mail: bsc@rema1000.dk .

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig. 

Vi vurderer ansøgningerne løbende, og jobannoncen vil derfor blive fjernet når passende kandidat er fundet.

ENGLISH:

We are currently looking for a Yard Driver to join REMA Distribution A/S, Hjulmagervej 12, Vejle in Denmark.

As an employee at REMA Distribution, you will become part of a company that aims to be the best at operating grocery stores in Denmark, with a focus on providing quality at low prices. You will play an important role in this process and become part of our yard shunter team in Vejle, working alongside skilled and competent colleagues.

About the job

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will be part of a team working closely with our warehouse and logistics department.

Responsibilities

·       Your duties will include:

·       Operating a yard driver within the terminal area.

·       Connect and Disconnect trailers.

·       Preparing trailers for loading and unloading.

·       Operating forklifts and carrying out internal transport.

·       Loading, unloading and handling goods.

·       Performing warehouse and terminal duties as required.

title: Anesthesia nurse are sought for Anesthesia Department 2
description: We are looking for anesthesia nurses who wish to work in a department that provides anesthesia for cardiac, pulmonary, vascular, and gastrointestinal surgery patients. You will become part of a dedicated and interdisciplinary team that values high professional standards, education, and good cooperation.Anesthesia Department 2We are organized into two specialty-based teams, with a focus on maintaining specialty-specific competencies while also helping one another across teams to create flexibility and variety in everyday work. We are looking for colleagues who are interested in both teams, but please mention any preference in your application.Team A:Handles anesthesia for abdominal surgery, ECT treatment, and interventional procedures (e.g., PTC and Coiling). The team also contributes to internal and external transfers and operates the IV team, specializing in advanced invasive access.Team TV:A highly specialized team providing anesthesia for cardiac, thoracic, and vascular surgery, as well as procedures in the cardiology catheterization laboratory, the pulmonary medicine outpatient clinic, and the radiology department. We receive emergency cardiac patients from the pre-hospital team, are part of the hospital's cardiac arrest team, and provide anesthesiology support in response to emergency calls within the hospital.Anesthesia Department 2 is a training site for nursing students, nurse anesthesia trainees, physicians in specialist training, and paramedics. During on-call shifts, we are responsible for the same clinical specialties as during daytime hours, but we also work as part of a broad cross-team on-call group. We support one another to ensure that the overall anesthesia workload in the operating suite runs smoothly for the benefit of patients. Regardless of patient category, we focus on maintaining a professional and compassionate nursing relationship with each patient. We would like to hear what, in your view, characterizes a good patient journey.We are looking for a colleague who...Already has or can obtain a Danish Authorization in accordance with Danish lawIs fluent in Danish, Norwegian or Swedish (preferably)  has a specialized education in anesthesia nursingthrives with both highly specialized and general anesthesia nursinghas a positive, flexible, and professional approach to changevalues professional quality and individual care for the patientcontributes actively to good cooperation and a healthy work environmentis eager to participate in our educational tasksWith us, you will receive...a thorough and individually tailored introduction programSupport from experienced colleagues, with a focus on both professional and social integrationAn exciting working environment with a high level of specialization and opportunities for professional discussion and peer supportA strong emphasis on education, development, and interdisciplinary collaborationGreat colleagues and room for individual differencesLanguage practice with an in-house consultant Working hours and planningDay shift: 7:30 a.m.- 3:15 p.m. (late shifts until 4:15 p.m., 5:15 p.m., and 6:15 p.m.)Evening/night shift: Four staff members start at 2:45 p.m. and work actively until 10:45 p.m., followed by an on-call shift from the staff on-call room until 7:30 a.m.We work with a 16-week rota cycle. Scheduling is carried out in close collaboration between the rota planner and clinical coordinators. Individual preferences are given high priority within the needs of the team and the requirements of the service.This year, we moved into new, modern facilities in Hospitalsbyen and are currently adapting to the new workflows. In addition, we currently have one abdominal surgery operating list per week at Aalborg Hospital South on Hobrovej.If you are passionate about anesthesia, professional excellence, and meaningful patient journeys, we look forward to hearing from you. Questions?For any questions regarding the position please contact Head Nurse Manager Merete Isaksen Dietz by phone on +45 30 56 75 32 or by e-mail at mli@rn.dk.For any questions regarding Danish authorization or the process hereof and language requirements, please contact HR Consultant Michelle Cederstrøm - m.cederstroem@rn.dk Practical informationSalary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable collective agreement for non-managerial staff within the Danish Health Confederation's area, concluded with the Danish Nurses' Organization. The position is 37 hours per week.The application deadline is 31. december 2026, and interviews are expected to take place in january. The preferred start date is 1 of february 2027, or by agreement.Place of workYour primary place of employment will be Anesthesia Department 2 in Aalborg. Your employment area is the North Denmark Region, with duties at Aalborg University Hospital, Anesthesia Aalborg. You may also be required to work in other departments within Anesthesia Aalborg, subject to the notice period for changes to the rota specified in the collective agreement.References will be obtained before an employment offer is made.About the North Denmark RegionThe North Denmark Region provides welfare services to approximately 590,000 people in North Jutland in the areas of healthcare, regional development, and specialized social services. Around 15,000 employees work together on this mission, bringing a wide range of professional expertise to create value every day for patients and citizens in North Jutland and to support a cohesive region. With us, you can build your career, make every day count, and make a difference. Read more about the region at www.rn.dk.

title: Anaesthetic Nurse Wanted - Anaesthesia Unit 1
description: Are you looking for new challenges? Would you like to work alongside skilled colleagues in an educational and dynamic environment where professional excellence and high-quality patient care are top priorities?You can expect a varied, fast-paced and sometimes unpredictable working day, with plenty of responsibility. In return, we promise you a workplace characterised by high job satisfaction and a strong sense of teamwork, where there is always room for humour and a smile, no matter how busy things get.About Anaesthesia Unit 1The unit covers several specialties and operates across two hospital sites. You will primarily be based at the new Hospital City East (Hospitalsbyen Øst), with only occasional shifts at Aalborg South. This advertisement describes the position within Anaesthesia Unit 1 East, which will be your primary place of employment.We bring together two specialties in a combined orthopaedic and neurosurgical anaesthesia unit.Neurosurgical anaesthesiaWe provide anaesthesia for:Intracranial surgeryConventional spinal and neurosurgerySurgery involving pain stimulation electrodesOrthopaedic anaesthesiaWe provide anaesthesia for both children and adults across all orthopaedic subspecialties, covering everything from day surgery to major spinal surgery.In addition, our responsibilities include:Providing emergency anaesthesia services for acutely ill medical patients in the Acute Treatment Centre (ATC).Receiving trauma patients as part of the hospital's trauma team.Managing patient transfers both within and outside the North Denmark Region.Providing anaesthesia for interventional radiology procedures.Providing anaesthesia for MRI and CT scans.We operate a total of eight operating theatres each day.Our team consists of approximately 34 anaesthetic nurses, including a Nurse Manager, two coordinating anaesthetic nurses, anaesthetic nurses working in the U and UU functions, and specialist pain nurses.The unit is also a clinical training site for:Nurses undertaking specialist training in anaesthesia.First-semester nursing students.Anaesthesiology doctors undertaking specialist training.Ambulance practitioners and paramedics.Medical personnel from the Danish Armed Forces.Make a Difference with UsAs an anaesthetic nurse, your primary responsibility will be to provide anaesthesia for both elective and emergency patients.You will quickly develop your ability to assess, analyse and make the right clinical decisions, working alongside a broad team of highly skilled colleagues who make a real difference to our patients every day.What We OfferYou can look forward to a challenging role with considerable responsibility and the opportunity to work across several specialties. You will also be involved in emergency anaesthesia duties throughout the hospital.The position involves a rotating shift pattern, including weekend shifts.In addition, we offer:Skilled, positive and dedicated colleagues who are committed to their own professional development and to advancing anaesthetic nursingA team that places great importance on maintaining a positive working environmentThe opportunity to submit preferences for your shift schedule through our OPTIMA scheduling systemYou will be in good hands from your very first day. Throughout your induction period, you will be supported by experienced colleagues who will ensure that you are well prepared to undertake your responsibilities independently.You will also have opportunities to attend relevant professional development courses, including:Courses at Aalborg University Hospital's Skills and Simulation Centre (Nord Sim).Simulation-based training within the unit.ATCN (Advanced Trauma Care for Nurses).Courses offered through FSAIO, both nationally and internationally.About YouYou contribute to a positive and respectful working environment and enjoy collaborating with colleagues in a busy setting involving complex, multidisciplinary care.You are recognised for your ability to communicate clearly and respectfully, including in challenging situations that require immediate action and sound clinical judgement.In addition, you:Hold a recognized specialist qualification in anaesthetic nursing.Already has or can obtain a Danish Authorization in accordance with Danish lawAre fluent in Danish, Norwegian or Swedish (preferably)Can communicate effectively with both patients and colleagues and actively contribute to a positive working environment in an ever-changing workplace.Have a positive attitude towards change and development. We experience plenty of both, whether we are refining our daily workflows or adapting to the new facilities and working procedures at Hospital City East.Are flexible, constructive and able to maintain an overview and create structure for yourself and your colleagues.Would You Like to Know More?If you are interested in the position and would like to learn more, please feel free to contact:Lotte JohansenNurse ManagerEmail: lotte.johansen@rn.dkTelephone: +45 41 46 77 51Clinical Unit Coordinators:Mia Nørgaard GranumEmail: mikg@rn.dkSigne MoosEmail: sim@rn.dkTelephone: +45 41 46 79 35For any questions regarding Danish authorization or the process hereof and language requirements, please contact HR Consultant Michelle Cederstrøm - m.cederstroem@rn.dkPractical InformationSalary and employment conditionsSalary and employment conditions will be in accordance with the applicable collective agreement for non-managerial staff within the Danish Health Professionals' Confederation (Sundhedskartellet), negotiated with the Danish Nurses' Organization (Dansk Sygeplejeråd).The position is full-time (37 hours per week). You will have the opportunity to influence your shift schedule so that it can be adapted to your individual needs.Application deadline: 31. December 2026Place of EmploymentYour primary place of employment will be Anaesthesia Unit 1 in Aalborg.Your employment area will cover the North Denmark Region, with your duties based at the Department of Anaesthesia, Aalborg University Hospital.Depending on operational requirements, you may also be required to work in other units within the Department of Anaesthesia in Aalborg, subject to the applicable collective agreement and notice requirements for changes to the duty roster.References will be obtained as part of the recruitment process.Find out more about the North Denmark Region at www.rn.dk.

title: Puhastustööde juht
description:
Tööülesanded: Korraldad sise- ja tootmisruumide igapäevast koristust ning eripuhastustöid. Juhid 35-liikmelist meeskonda: osaled töötajate värbamises, juhendad ja koolitad töötajaid, koostad töögraafikuid ning korraldad asendusi. Kontrollid isiklikult objektidel töö kvaliteeti ja ohutusnõuete järgimist, selgitad välja puuduste põhjused ning tagad nende kõrvaldamise. Arvutad Excelis tööajanorme, töömahte, personali- ja materjalivajadust ning teenuste omahinda ja maksumust. Analüüsid kulusid ja ressursside kasutamise tõhusust. Suhtled klientidega, koostad ja põhjendad hinnapakkumisi, lepid kokku töökorralduslikke muudatusi ning lahendad igapäevaseid küsimusi ja pretensioone. Planeerid ja korraldad tööd nii, et teenuse kvaliteet oleks tagatud ning personali, tööaja ja materjalide kasutamine oleks tõhus.

Omalt poolt pakume: Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu. Stabiilset tööd BLRT Grupi ettevõttes. Iseseisvust töö korraldamisel ja võimalust oma teadmisi rakendada. Administratiivset tuge ostude, arvestuse ja dokumentatsiooni korraldamisel. Isikliku auto kasutamise hüvitist tööalaste sõitude eest. Kaasaegseid ja ergonoomilisi töövahendeid. BLRT Grupi töötajate tunnustamise poliitikas määratletud soodustusi. Tööpiirkond: Tallinn ja Maardu. Tööaeg: täistööaeg, paindlik tööajagraafik.

Muud nõuded: Kehtiv Puhastustööde juht, tase 5 kutsetunnistus. Puhastustööde korraldamise ja meeskonna juhtimise kogemus, vähemalt 3 aastat. Puhastustehnoloogiate, töömeetodite ja kvaliteedinõuete hea tundmine, sealhulgas tootmisruumide koristamise eripärade mõistmine. Hea Exceli kasutamise oskus: valemid, arvutused, liigendtabelid, tööaja ja kulude arvestus ning andmete analüüs. Hea arvutikasutamise oskus: MS Wordi ja Outlooki kindel kasutamine ning oskus töötada ettevõtte infosüsteemides ja koostada tööalast dokumentatsiooni. Analüütiline mõtlemine, iseseisev otsustusvõime, hea organiseerimisoskus ja vastutustunne. Oskus töötajaid juhendada ja õpetada, klientidega professionaalselt suhelda ning probleeme lahendada. Eesti ja vene keele oskus iseseisvaks tööalaseks suhtlemiseks ja dokumentidega töötamiseks, vähemalt B2-tasemel.

title: Noorem ostuspetsialist
description:
Tööülesanded: Sinu peamiseks ülesandeks on toetada ettevõtte tarneahela sujuvat toimimist. Igapäevaselt suhtled tarnijate ja alltöövõtjatega, pead hinnaläbirääkimisi ning sõlmid kokkuleppeid, et tagada tootmiseks vajalike materjalide, komponentide, pooltoodete ja alltöövõtuteenuste õigeaegne olemasolu. Teed ostutellimusi, sisestad tarnijatelt saadud pakkumised ja hinnainfo kalkulatsioonitabelitesse ning jälgid tellimuste täitmist ja kokkulepitud tarnetähtaegadest kinnipidamist. Töötad tihedas koostöös tootmise ja teiste kolleegidega, et ostuprotsessid kulgeksid sujuvalt ning ettevõtte eesmärgid saaksid täidetud.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meid juhib soov anda inimestele vabadus teha asju, mida nad päriselt teha tahavad – asju, mis loovad uut väärtust. Teeme seda, luues tehastele nutikaid automatiseerimislahendusi ja aidates ettevõtetel tuua turule uued targad masinad. Keskmise suurusega ettevõttena saame tegutseda kiiresti ja paindlikult, teha otsuseid operatiivselt ning reageerida klientide vajadustele. Väljakutsuvad projektid: lähtume iga kliendi ainulaadsetest vajadustest ja loome just neile sobiva lahenduse. Kogenud meeskond: hindame üksteise kogemusi, jagame oma teadmisi ja toetame üksteist igapäevases töös. Arenemisvõimalus: meie juures saad alustada nooremspetsialistina, arendada oma oskusi ja kasvada kogemuste lisandudes vanemspetsialistiks või oma valdkonna eksperdiks. Toetame sinu arengut ning anname võimaluse liikuda samm-sammult suurema vastutuse ja uute väljakutsete poole. Kiirus ja paindlikkus: keskmise suurusega ettevõttena suudame otsuseid teha kiiresti ja viia head ideed kiiresti tootmisesse. Hoiak: teeme ära. Armastame väljakutseid ja anname igas projektis endast parima – poolikuid lahendusi me ei tee.

Muud nõuded: Oled täpne, süsteemne ja hea suhtleja, kellele meeldib leida lahendusi ning teha koostööd nii tarnijate, alltöövõtjate kui ka kolleegidega. Sul on huvi tehnilise valdkonna vastu ning soov õppida tundma ostuprotsesse ja tarneahela toimimist. Oled julge suhtleja, avatud uutele väljakutsetele ning valmis arendama oma oskusi läbirääkimiste pidamisel ja koostöösuhete loomisel. Tunned end kindlalt arvutiga töötades ning valdad väga hästi eesti ja inglise keelt nii kõnes kui ka kirjas. Sul on vähemalt keskeriharidus, eelistatult tehnilise suunitlusega. Kasuks tuleb tehniliste jooniste lugemise oskus ning varasem töökogemus ostuspetsialisti, tehnoloogi või mõnes muus tehnilises rollis tootmisettevõttes, kuid kõige olulisemad on sinu huvi, õppimisvalmidus ja soov areneda.

erivajadusega inimestele

Tööülesanded: Täiskasvanute tegevusvõime, igapäevaelu oskuste ning iseseisva toimetuleku hindamine ja toetamine.Individuaalsete tegevusteraapia eesmärkide seadmine ning teraapiaplaanide koostamine vastavalt kliendi vajadustele ja võimetele. Individuaalsete tegevusteraapia seansside läbiviimine, vajadusel grupitegevuste juhendamine. Klientide motoorsete, kognitiivsete, sensoorsete ja sotsiaalsete oskuste arendamine ning säilitamine. Igapäevaeluks vajalike oskuste õpetamine, sealhulgas enesehooldus, riietumine, söömine, kodused toimingud ja ajaplaneerimine. Klientide lähedaste nõustamine ja juhendamine igapäevase toimetuleku toetamisel. Koostöö teiste spetsialistide, tegevusjuhendajate, tugivõrgustiku ja pereliikmetega. Kliendi arengu ja teraapia tulemuslikkuse hindamine ning vajaliku dokumentatsiooni koostamine ja täitmine. Osalemine rehabilitatsiooniplaanide ja individuaalsete tegevuskavade koostamises ning nende elluviimises.

Meeldivat ja toetavat töökeskkonda, kus on võimalus rakendada erinevaid tegevusteraapia meetodeid. Võimalust töötada erineva toevajadusega täiskasvanutega ja lastega, toetades nende iseseisvust, tegevusvõimet ja igapäevast toimetulekut.

Muud nõuded: Ootame oma meeskonda sooja südamega, empaatilist ja rõõmsameelset inimest, kes väärtustab iga inimese eripära ning oskab märgata ja tunnustada ka väikeseid edusamme. title: Kodushooldaja
description:
Koduhooldustöötaja

Tööülesanded: Aita inimestel elada väärikalt oma kodus!Estkeer otsib oma Tallinna meeskonda hoolivat, usaldusväärset ja vastutustundlikku koduhooldustöötajat. Meie töö eesmärk on toetada eakaid ja abivajavaid inimesi nende igapäevastes tegevustes, et nad saaksid võimalikult kaua, turvaliselt ja väärikalt oma kodus elada. Ootame oma meeskonda inimest, kellele läheb korda teiste heaolu ning kes soovib teha tähendusrikast ja vaheldusrikast tööd. Koduhooldustöötajana abistad kliente nende kodus vastavalt individuaalsele abivajadusele ja kokkulepitud hooldusplaanile. Sinu peamised tööülesanded on: *Abistamine igapäevastes hügieenitoimingutes (pesemine, riietumine, tualetitoimingud, mähkmete vahetamine). *Toidu valmistamine, serveerimine ja vajadusel abistamine söömisel. *Kliendi liikumise ja igapäevase aktiivsuse toetamine, abistamine liikumisel ning jalutuskäikudel. *Kergemad kodused majapidamistööd (koristamine, nõude pesemine, pesu- ja voodipesu vahetamine). *Toiduainete ja muude esmatarbekaupade ostmine. *Kliendi saatmine arsti vastuvõtule ja teistele vajalikele käikudele. *Vestlemine ja kliendi sotsiaalse aktiivsuse toetamine. *Tehtud hooldustoimingute dokumenteerimine. Töö toimub klientide kodudes. Tööpäeva jooksul külastatakse vastavalt graafikule ühte või mitut klienti. Külastuste kestus sõltub kliendi abivajadusest. Töö hõlmab hommikusi, päevaseid ja õhtuseid hoolduskülastusi ning vajalik on valmisolek töötada ka öistes vahetustes kliendi kodus.

Omalt poolt pakume: *Tähendusrikast tööd, kus Sinu panus mõjutab otseselt inimeste igapäevast heaolu.*Toetavat ja kokkuhoidvat meeskonda. *Sisseelamisprogrammi, kohapealset juhendamist ja regulaarseid sisekoolitusi. *Paindlikku töögraafikut ning võimalust töötada täis- või osalise tööajaga. *Mitmekesist ja iseseisvat tööd. *Tööks vajalikke vahendeid ja tööriietust. *Võimalust kasutada tööülesannete täitmiseks ametiautot või kokkuleppel isiklikku autot koos sõidukulude hüvitamisega. *Võimalust areneda ja täiendada oma oskusi hooldusvaldkonnas.

description: About the roleAs a QA &amp; Test Lead, you will oversee the planning, design, implementation, and execution of all quality assurance and testing activities across the program, ensuring high-quality delivery through comprehensive QA governance and testing management.The position is based in Helsinki, with the option to work mainly remotely if you prefer. The duration of the employment is from 1/2027 to 12/2028.Work tasks- QA strategy &amp; governance: Defining, maintaining, and overseeing the QA process, framework, guidelines, and quality gates across all program workstreams, including satellite projects.- End-to-end quality oversight: Managing development process quality from requirements to production and ensuring all project parties establish agreed quality controls.- Team &amp; resource leadership: Onboarding, training, and managing testing resources, as well as defining key skills needed for testers.- Test management &amp; tooling: Defining testing tools, templates, best practices, and standards, and overseeing the maintenance of test plans, cases, scripts, and reports.- Test automation &amp; CI/CD: Implementing and overseeing test automation tools, their configuration, and execution to support continuous delivery.- Defect &amp; metrics management: Governing bug/defect tracking and resolution, and overseeing quality metrics, KPIs, and status/risk reporting to program leadership.- Analytics &amp; corrective actions: Analyzing test results to draw actionable insights and leading remedial and corrective actions when deviations occur.- Continuous improvement: Driving ongoing enhancements in quality management and delivery processes by collecting feedback and applying lessons learned.We are looking for- Proven QA &amp; testing experience: Strong track record in QA governance, test design, and leading testing processes in large-scale programs.- Technical &amp; process expertise: Solid understanding of SDLC, IT processes (ITIL), operating models, test automation tools, and cybersecurity standards and controls.- Modern delivery mindset: Familiarity with continuous improvement, CI/CD practices, and leveraging modern technologies such as AI in quality assurance.- Leadership &amp; communication: Demonstrated ability in resource management, vision-setting, and clear stakeholder communication across teams and leadership.- Analytical &amp; detail-oriented approach: Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills combined with high attention to detail and a result-oriented mindset.- Fluency in English, Finnish and Swedish are considered as an advantage.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Kahvilatyöntekijä, Relove Freda, Helsinki
description: Nyt on loistava mahdollisuus päästä osaksi Reloven Fredalla sijaitsevan kahvilan tiimiä! Etsimme uutta osa-aikaista kahvilatyöntekijää Punavuoren uniikkiin ympäristöön.Relove on kotimainen, arvoihin nojaava perheyritys, joka yhdistää vastuullisen muodin, laadukkaat kahvilatuotteet ja sydämellisen asiakaspalvelun ainutlaatuiseksi kokonaisuudeksi. Me tarjoamme makuelämyksiä sesongin raaka-aineista ja ennen kaikkea kohtaamisia, jotka jäävät mieleen.Kahvilatyöntekijänä olet tärkeässä roolissa luomassa asiakkaille mukavia kahvilahetkiä. Palvelet asiakkaita, työskentelet kassalla ja keittiössä itsenäisesti, valmistat erikoiskahveja, vitriinituotteita ja vaikkapa lounasannoksia sekä pidät huolta viihtyisästä ja siististä ympäristöstä. Huomioithan, että meillä työskennellään kahvilan puolella ajoittain myös yksin.Jotta solahtaisit Reloven monipuoliseen kahvilatoimintaan, edellytetään sinulta useamman vuoden kokemusta kahvila- ja/tai ravintolatyöskentelystä, erinomaisia asiakaspalvelutaitoja, myyntihenkisyyttä sekä kykyä toimia kiireisessä ympäristössä. Mikäli sinulta löytyy aiempaa kokemusta erikoiskahvien valmistuksesta, kerrothan myös tästä hakemuksessasi.Vastapainoa työn hektisyydelle tuovat työn parhaat puolet - ihanat asiakkaat, lämmin ja kannustava työilmapiiri ja sydämelliset kollegat. Relovessa persoonallisuus näkyy niin sisustuksessa, tuotevalikoimassa kuin asiakaspalvelussa eli Sinussa! Reloven konseptia kehitetään jatkuvasti ja tehtävässä on mahdollista päästä oikeasti tuomaan esille omaa näkemystä ja visioita. Työsuhde-etuina saat käyttöösi ePassi-edut, kattavan työterveyshuollon, alennusta kahvilatuotteista sekä omasta vaatteiden myyntijaksosta Relovessa.Työsuhteen tiedot:- Työsuhdemuoto:Vakituinen ja osa-aikainen (60h/3vko)- Työajat: Maanantaista sunnuntaihin klo 07-20 välillä- Palkka:MaRaVa-tes:n mukainen 13,70-15,04€/h kokemuksesi mukaan- Aloitus:Joustavasti mahdollisimman pianTyö edellyttää täysi-ikäisyyttä sekä hygienia- ja anniskelupassia. Työssä tarvitset sujuvan suomen kielen lisäksi myös englannin kielen taitoa. Lisäksi terveydentilan selvitys salmonellatartunnasta vaaditaan ennen töiden aloitusta.Mikäli jaat arvomme vastuullisuudesta, edelläkävijyydestä sekä lempeydestä, hae mukaan joukkoomme. Koska kierrättäminen on kaunista.Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Barona toimii rekrytoinnin yhteistyökumppanina. Valitut henkilöt solmivat työsuhteet Reloven kanssa.HUOM! Jätäthän hakemuksen hakulomakkeen kautta, sillä emme voi tietoturvasyistä huomioida sähköpostitse jätettyjä hakemuksia.Hakeaksesi avoimia työpaikkoja, sinun tulee luoda työnhakuprofiili Barona Careersiin. Täytät profiilisi vain kerran, minkä jälkeen voit hakea kaikkia Baronan työpaikkoja samalla profiililla. Suosittelemme sinulle sopivia työpaikkoja työkokemuksesi, koulutustaustasi ja taitojesi perusteella. Barona Careers tekee työnhaustasi helpompaa kuin koskaan!

title: Lärare/socionom i barnomsorg
description: Lemlands kommuns barnomsorg lediganslår nu ordinarie befattningar som lärare i barnomsorg alternativt socionom i barnomsorg.Arbetet inleds i januari eller enligt överenskommelse och anställningarna har inledande placeringar på daghemmet Gullvivan.**Din profil**Vi söker dig som har behörighet som lärare i barnomsorg eller socionom i barnomsorg i enlighet med ÅFS 2020:99. Personliga egenskaper vi värdesätter är att du har god samarbetsförmåga samt är ansvarsfull, flexibel och lösningsfokuserad. Du har ett respektfullt och professionellt förhållningssätt till barn, vårdnadshavare och kollegor och övriga du möter i din yrkesroll. Som person bidrar du till positivitet, lyhördhet och engagemang i verksamheten.I enlighet med landskapslagen (2020:32) om barnomsorg och grundskola är svenska vårt verksamhets- och arbetsspråk, vilket kräver goda kunskaper i tal och skrift.**Din roll hos oss**Som lärare i barnomsorg ansvarar du för det pedagogiska arbetet på din avdelning och för att verksamheten följer aktuella styrdokument. Du arbetar i team med övrig pedagogisk personal på din avdelning, där du har en ledande position, och samarbetar även med resten av personalen på daghemmet samt med speciallärare och övriga sakkunniga. Tillsammans med dina kollegor skapar ni gemensamt kvalitativ småbarnspedagogik där barnet alltid är i fokus. Du handhar även förundervisningen samt ansvarar för samarbetet med barnens vårdnadshavare.Som socionom i barnomsorg ansvarar du i samråd med lärare för det pedagogiska arbetet på din avdelning och för att verksamheten följer aktuella styrdokument. Du arbetar i team med övrig pedagogisk personal på din avdelning, där du har en ledande position och kompletterar med din kunskap om att stärka barnets sociala utveckling och att vid behov stöda familjernas resurser och välmående position. Du samarbetar även med resten av personalen på daghemmet samt med speciallärare och övriga sakkunniga. Tillsammans med dina kollegor skapar ni gemensamt kvalitativ småbarnspedagogik där barnet alltid är i fokus. Du ansvarar även för samarbetet med barnens vårdnadshavare.Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och lämplighet.Uppvisat straffregisterutdrag krävs av de som blir valda. En prövotid kan komma att tillämpas.Grundlönen för en heltidsanställd behörig lärare i barnomsorg är 3285,56 €/ månad.Grundlönen för en heltidsanställd socionom i barnomsorg är 3228,16€/ månad.Eventuella erfarenhetstilägg tillkommer.**Vår rekryteringsprocess**Lemlands kommun rekryterar fördomsfritt och objektivt. Intervjuer kan ske löpande under ansökningstiden.Närmare upplysningar angående arbetet och våra daghem ges av Gullvivans föreståndare.Gullvivan: Anu-Riikka Eriksson på tel: 018-349 450**ANSÖKAN** Vi ser fram emot att få din ansökan senast 3 december klockan 23:59. I ansökan vill vi att du har med ett personligt brev och CV som bifogade filer. Ansökan skickas in i första hand via Lemlands kommuns E-tjänster: https://e-tjanster.ax/e-form/sv/c7fa9da3e3Alternativt via postadress: Lemlands Kommun, Kommunrundan 7, 22610 Lemland. Märk ansökan med lärare/socionom i barnomsorg och lärare i förundervisning.**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!**

title: HR Manager, Scandic, Tukikonttori Espoo
description: JOIN SCANDIC'S HR TEAM!We are looking for an HR Manager to support our Finnish hotels and contribute to Scandics continued success.This is a broad and hands-on HR role, closely connected to our hotel operations. You will work as a trusted advisor to the managers, supporting leaders and teams across the district in day-to-day HR matters like labour law, occupational health care, leadership, staffing and recruitment.This position is located in Finland, with the office in Espoo, Tapiola. At Scandic we believe that strong collaboration, as well as learning and development are best supported through regular in-person interaction and therefore we primarily work from the office.WHAT WE OFFERWe offer you a versatile working environment within a major hotel chain, providing countless opportunities for professional growth and development. Our employee benefits include; food and beverage discounts in our restaurants, ePassi, health care benefits and insurance. Scandic Academy also offers a comprehensive training program, and all employees receive additional job-related training whenever needed.YOUR MISSIONAs HR Manager, you play a key role in supporting both people and business. You are the go-to HR expert in your own field and work closely with managers in people-related matters as well as to ensure great leadership and operational excellence.In this role, you will:\- Act as a key HR partner to leaders in hotel operations from daily coaching to complex HR matters.\- You support correct application of Finnish labor law and collective agreements (MaRa).\- Coach and support managers in matters related to sick leave and work ability, including long-term absences, return-to-work situations and workplace adjustments, working closely with occupational health care and other relevant partners.\- Support and develop managers in all people-related areas like performance, recruitment (including co-operation with our outsourcing partners), culture and leadership.\- Ensure implementation, compliance and continuous improvement of HR processes, based on local needs.\- Promote a healthy, safe and sustainable work environment together with managers and stakeholders.\- Act as a culture ambassador and ensure Scandics values are reflected in leadership and everyday behavior.\- Share insights from your district to help shape the wider HR agenda and ways of working.\- You report to the HR Director Finland and are part of both the country HR team and the larger Scandic HR network.WHO YOU AREIn this role you represent our values Be Caring, Be You, Be a Pro and Be Bold in the following manner:Be Caring – you are open-minded and enjoy collaborating and building trust on all levels of the organization, while helping managers to grow and succeed.Be You – you bring your own wonderful warm and friendly personality in everything you do.Be a Pro – you are structured and proactive and thrive in a high-paced and people-intensive environment.Be Bold – you are confident in your role, bringing strong integrity, self-awareness, drive and clear communication. You are empathic, but also confident enough to challenge others when needed.WHAT YOU BRING\- 5+ years of broad HR experience, with strong understanding in labor law and occupational health care.\- Proven track record in developing work ability management and related KPIs.\- A strong business mindset and the ability to support leaders in aligning people and operations.\- Strong ability to collaborate and build trust on all levels of the organization.\- Support and challenge leaders in a bold and positive way.\- Relevant academic background or equivalent practical experience.\- Full professional fluency in both Finnish and English.Salary: The salary will range between 4500eur-5500eur. The salary offered will be determined based on the candidate's previous experience, qualifications and how well their skills and competencies align with the expectation and requirements of the role.For more information about the position, please contact:HR Director Pia Tuomi 0403549996 during the following times: 16.11.2026 at 16.00-17.00 and 19.11.2026 at 8.00-9.00.Interested? Fantastic!Please apply through the link above. Feel free to send your application in either Finnish or English.Scandic is the leading hotel company in the Nordics. We want to be like a friend in town for people on the road – and friends know what friends need. We believe that great hospitality starts with us, in every role and every interaction. What you do here makes a real difference.A warm welcome, a thoughtful detail or support for a colleague – your actions shape the moments that matter for our guests, for each other and for the world around us. At Scandic, you can be yourself, use your strengths and let your passion create experiences people want to return to. Together, we make everyone feel welcome and at home – just like friends do.

title: On-Call Trainee, Corporate Tax and Legal
description: We are looking for an On-Call Trainee, Corporate Tax and Legal, with the main responsibility of assisting our teams with various tax and legal matters. The position is estimated to involve approximately two working days per week. The preferred location for this position is Helsinki, Finland. We offer the possibility of hybrid work.As an On-Call Trainee, you can work up to 25 hours per week. The person selected for this role needs to be a full-time student studying for a degree in Finland.Your role and responsibilitiesAs an On-Call Trainee, Corporate Tax and Legal, your work will include tasks related to income tax, transfer pricing, international tax matters, indirect tax, as well as other tasks within the Group Tax team and tasks within the Corporate & M&A Legal team. Youll be working as part of the Group Tax team and the Corporate & M&A Legal team in a truly international environment. You will probably start many of your tasks by checking Google Maps to see where the relevant company is located, as Wärtsilä has companies or branches in over 100 countries.To succeed in the position, we expect you to have: * Late-stage Bachelors or mid- to late-stage Masters level studies in Economics and Business Administration, Law, or a similar field * Interest in taxation and motivation to learn about income tax, transfer pricing, indirect tax, and international taxation * Interest in gaining insight into and participating in corporate legal work * Excellent communication and writing skills in English; Finnish or Swedish language skills are considered an advantage * Some relevant previous work experience; experience in taxation and/or law is a plus but not mandatory * An organised, focused, and proactive working style with a flexible and positive attitude * Experience using various IT systems and tools, especially Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; experience with SAP is an advantageWhats in it for you? * The opportunity to learn about taxation and law, and the roles and responsibilities of the Tax and Legal functions of an international listed company * Induction and training, professional development within the fields of tax and law, and valuable hands-on experience * The opportunity to become a valued and integral member of the Group Tax team, with support for your studies and future career, as well as the opportunity to participate in and become integrated into the tasks of the Corporate & M&A Legal team * Flexible working hours and the possibility to work partly remotelyWhy you and us?We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking for a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.Contact & next stepsWe hope to hear from you soon and receive your application via our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated throughout the process.For further information regarding this position, please reach out to Jouni Arpalahti, Director, Corporate Taxes, at jouni.arpalahti@wartsila.com regarding this position (only for questions from direct job applicants; applications by email will not be recorded or responded to).Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!

title: Supplier Development Engineer
