Vi utgår från Vänersborg, driver fyra matvagnar och tar nu ansvar för fler delar av stora event.Upplägget börjar med tre månaders praktik. Vår ambition är att praktiken ska kunna leda till anställning, beroende på prestation och personlig lämplighet.Du arbetar nära företagets ägare och personalansvarig och får insyn i hela processen, från de första arrangörskontakterna till genomförandet på plats och uppföljningen efteråt. Under praktiken får du handledning och successivt större ansvar i takt med att du lär känna verksamheten.Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar att:    Planera våra eventuppdrag och ta fram tidsplaner och checklistor.    Samordna praktiska frågor kring matvagnar, bemanning, transporter och resor tillsammans med företagets ägare.    Hålla kontakt med arrangörer, leverantörer och samarbetspartner.    Aktivt söka upp nya event, kontakta arrangörer och följa upp kontakter för att skapa fler uppdrag.    Delta i genomförandet på plats och hantera förändringar tillsammans med teamet.    Följa upp genomförda event och bidra till bättre rutiner inför nästa uppdrag.Vi söker dig som skapar struktur, tar initiativ och följer upp det du påbörjar. Du kan prioritera mellan flera uppgifter, hålla deadlines och kommunicera tydligt när förutsättningarna ändras. Du är bekväm med att kontakta nya människor och förstår att rollen också handlar om att skapa affärer.Erfarenhet av event, samordning, försäljning, restaurang eller service är meriterande. Vi lägger stor vikt vid ditt omdöme, ditt engagemang och din förmåga att få saker genomförda.En stor del av planeringsarbetet kan utföras hemifrån. Arbetet följer ett överenskommet schema, med tydliga uppgifter och regelbundna avstämningar. Rollen innebär också arbete på plats vid event samt resor och övernattningar på andra orter.Sommaren är vår högsäsong, med ett högt arbetstempo och periodvis längre arbetsdagar. Kvälls- och helgarbete förekommer. Om praktiken leder till anställning är inriktningen mer arbete under sommaren och större utrymme för ledighet under lugnare delar av året. Arbetstid och ledighet planeras enligt överenskommelse.Hos oss får du möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt och bidra till företagets utveckling. Om samarbetet fungerar väl och verksamheten växer kan du på sikt få en ledande roll.Skicka ditt CV och en kort presentation till support@lulusstreetfood.com. Märk ansökan Eventkoordinator och ange när du kan börja.Berätta gärna om något du har planerat eller samordnat, vilket ansvar du hade och hur du löste utmaningar som uppstod.

title: Tandläkare till Öland - PTJ Tandvårdsgruppen Borgholm
description: Är du tandläkare och vill utvecklas tillsammans med erfarna kollegor i en modern och engagerad arbetsmiljö?Tandvårdsgruppen i Borgholm söker en tandläkare till sitt sammansvetsade team. Här erbjuds ett brett behandlingspanorama, kliniskt stöd och utvecklingsmöjligheter inom bland annat protetik och kirurgi. I november 2026 flyttar kliniken dessutom till helt nya, havsnära lokaler!Praktisk information    Arbetsplats: PTJ Tandvårdsgruppen i Borgholm på Öland    Roll: Allmäntandläkare    Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning på heltid (32 timmar kliniskt) med inledande provanställning    Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse    Trygghet och hälsa: Kollektivavtal och friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr/år vid heltid    Arbetstider: Dagtid, måndag–torsdag cirka 07.10–16.15 och fredag till cirka 12.30.Om Tandvårdsgruppen i BorgholmTandvårdsgruppen är en del av Praktikertjänst och erbjuder modern allmäntandvård med ett brett behandlingsutbud för vuxna patienter.Kliniken har cirka 1 500 aktiva patienter, fyra behandlingsrum och sju medarbetare. Med god patienttillströmning och vanligtvis fullbokade tidböcker finns goda förutsättningar att arbeta kliniskt från start.Här arbetar erfarna tandsköterskor med ett välutvecklat delegerat arbetssätt och administrativt stöd från receptionen, vilket ger dig möjlighet att fokusera på patientbehandling.Arbetsmiljön präglas av nära samarbete, kunskapsutbyte, utveckling och humor, där kollegorna stöttar varandra och har roligt tillsammans.Om rollenSom tandläkare arbetar du främst med vuxna patienter med varierande, ibland omfattande behandlingsbehov. Du ansvarar självständigt för undersökningar, diagnostik, terapiplanering och behandling utifrån patientens individuella behov.Du erbjuds ett brett behandlingspanorama med möjlighet att utvecklas inom områden som intresserar dig. Kliniken arbetar delegerat och ser gärna att du är öppen för att arbeta växelvis i två behandlingsrum, med stöd av erfarna tandsköterskor.Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. Det viktigaste är en god odontologisk grund, vilja att utvecklas och uppskattning för ett nära teamarbete.Vi söker dig somVi söker en trygg och samarbetsorienterad tandläkare som tycker om sitt yrke, tar ansvar för sina patienter och vill fortsätta utvecklas.Du har ett genuint intresse för odontologi och förmågan att se patientens behov ur ett helhetsperspektiv. Du arbetar självständigt men uppskattar att diskutera behandlingsalternativ och lära av kollegor.Som person är du prestigelös, lösningsorienterad och mottaglig för återkoppling. Du kommunicerar tydligt och bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö och ett nära samarbete.Vi lägger stor vikt vid din samarbetsförmåga, ditt kliniska omdöme och din vilja att utvecklas tillsammans med teamet.Krav✅ Svensk tandläkarlegitimation utfärdad av Socialstyrelsen✅ Minst tre års klinisk erfarenhet som tandläkare i Sverige✅ Flytande svenska✅ Förmåga att arbeta självständigt med allmäntandvård och terapiplaneringPlus i kanten➕ Erfarenhet av att arbeta delegerat eller växelvis i två behandlingsrum➕ Erfarenhet eller särskilt intresse för protetik och kirurgi➕ Erfarenhet från specialisttandvård eller fördjupad odontologisk kompetens➕ Erfarenhet av digitala arbetsflöden och intraoral scanningDu behöver inte uppfylla samtliga meriterande önskemål. Vi värdesätter din potential, ditt kliniska omdöme och din vilja att fortsätta utvecklas.Vårt erbjudandeHos Tandvårdsgruppen får du en modern arbetsplats med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, stöd från erfarna kollegor och en arbetsmiljö där trivsel och samarbete står i centrum.Du erbjuds bland annat:    Nya, moderna lokaler – nybyggd klinik med inflyttning i november 2026.    Brett behandlingspanorama – varierande patientfall och utveckling inom bland annat protetik, parodontal kirurgi och implantatkirurgi.    Kliniskt stöd och mentorskap – från en erfaren klinikchef med bred odontologisk kompetens.    Kompetensutveckling – möjlighet till intern och extern vidareutbildning.    Erfaret team – kunniga tandsköterskor och administrativt stöd.    God patienttillströmning – etablerad patientstock och välfyllda tidböcker.    Trygga anställningsvillkor – kollektivavtal, tjänstepension och friskvårdsbidrag.    Attraktiva arbetstider – dagtid, lediga kvällar och helger samt tidig avslutning på fredagar.Framför allt blir du en del av ett sammansvetsat team där kollegorna stöttar varandra, delar kunskap och har roligt tillsammans!Ansök utan CV idag!I denna rekrytering samarbetar arbetsgivaren med Odonti som sköter hela rekryteringsprocessen.Detta är en direktrekrytering, vilket innebär att du blir anställd av Tandvårdsgruppen Borgholm.För en professionell, rättvis och strukturerad rekryteringsprocess sker ansökan och all kommunikation gällande tjänsten via Odonti.Vid frågor är du varmt välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare på Odonti 👇🏼Ansvarig rekryterareJashar Samadi 📧 hej@odonti.se 📞 0709220250🎁 TipsgåvaKänner du den vi söker? Tipsa oss om rätt person. Leder ditt tips till en tillsvidareanställning får du en gåva från oss 🎉Om OdontiOdonti är ett rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag inom dentalbranschen. Vi rekryterar till fasta tjänster och hyr ut konsulter till tidsbegränsade uppdrag utifrån deras tillgänglighet och önskemål.Över 10.000 yrkesverksamma inom svensk tandvård har connectat och finns i vår kandidatdatabas och nätverk. Connecta gärna med oss på 👉🏼 Odonti.seDin profil hanteras konfidentiellt enligt GDPR och delas aldrig utan ditt godkännande.

title: Senior Reliability Engineer
description: Join us as a Senior Reliability Engineer and play a key role in ensuring the long-term performance and reliability of critical manufacturing assets.The position is part of the local Maintenance & Reliability organisation in Uppsala and works cross-functionally with Engineering, Production, Quality Assurance and other key stakeholders.As a Senior Reliability Engineer, you will act as a key technical specialist on both operational and strategic levels, driving the development of a proactive, data-driven reliability and maintenance culture. You will also collaborate closely with Galderma's global reliability organisation to ensure alignment with corporate standards, best practices and long-term strategic objectives.We're looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive mindset, takes ownership of complex challenges and is motivated by turning analysis into action.Make your mark. Grow with us.  Your missionAs a Senior Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability and long-term performance of manufacturing systems and equipment across our operations.Using data, engineering expertise and structured problem solving, you will identify improvement opportunities, assess equipment and asset lifecycles, and support decisions on maintenance strategies, upgrades and future investments.In this role, you will provide subject matter expertise in reliability engineering and asset performance management, supporting both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic initiatives. Through collaboration with local and global stakeholders, you will help shape maintenance practices, improve asset reliability and contribute to sustainable business performance.This is a senior role that requires a high degree of ownership and initiative. You are comfortable working independently, building strong relationships across functions and driving improvements from idea through to implementation.You will join a team of experienced engineers who play an important role in supporting operational excellence and the continued development of our Uppsala site. Key Responsibilities· Drive reliability engineering initiatives across manufacturing operations, systems and equipment.· Lead and facilitate reliability assessments using methodologies such as RCA, RCM, FMEA and FMECA.· Analyse equipment performance, identify failure patterns and implement measurable reliability improvements.· Develop and optimise preventive maintenance strategies to improve asset availability and reduce operational risk.· Support asset lifecycle management and contribute to investment decisions through data-driven recommendations.· Monitor and improve maintenance performance indicators (KPIs) and reliability metrics.· Collaborate with stakeholders across Engineering, Production, Automation, QA and Facilities to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.· Collaborate with Galderma's global reliability organisation to ensure alignment with company standards and strategic objectives.· Promote a proactive, reliability-focused culture through coaching, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.· Lead root cause investigations and drive corrective and preventive actions to improve operational performance Your profile You are an experienced engineer with a background in reliability engineering, maintenance engineering or asset management within an industrial environment.You are comfortable working with complex technical challenges and understand how to translate data into practical actions and long-term improvements. Equally important, you take ownership, build trust with stakeholders and thrive in an environment where initiative and collaboration are valued. What you'll bring· A university degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.· Minimum 5 years of experience within reliability engineering, maintenance engineering or asset management in an industrial environment.· Strong knowledge and practical experience of reliability methodologies such as RCA, RCM, FMEA/FMECA and preventive maintenance optimisation.· Proven ability to analyse equipment performance, identify failure patterns and implement sustainable reliability improvements.· Experience working with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) and maintenance performance indicators (KPIs).· Strong knowledge of asset lifecycle management and maintenance strategies.· Experience from a regulated manufacturing environment.· Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.· Professional proficiency in English, written and spoken. Swedish is considered an advantage. Location and otherThis position is based on site in Uppsala, Sweden. We review applications on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application date. We therefore encourage interested candidates to submit their application as soon as possible. Why GaldermaAt Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

title: 3D Model responsible
description: A Snapshot of Your DayJoin us as a Layout Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in coordinating the overall design of our projects. You will leverage your strong CAD skills, preferably in NX, to create and manage 3D models that accurately reflect the combined input from various engineering disciplines. Your attention to detail and structured approach will ensure that all layout drawings meet project requirements and support customer planning for foundations, buildings, and utilities. Collaborating closely with project teams and customers, you will contribute to successful project execution while continuously learning and developing your knowledge of our products and engineering processes. This role is based in Finspång, and you will need to be present on-site, with some flexibility required for business travel to visit customers as needed. How You’ll Make an Impact     You will utilize your CAD expertise to create and manage detailed 3D models, ensuring alignment with mechanical, piping, electrical, and instrumentation disciplines.     Collaborate effectively with project teams and customers to produce layout drawings that facilitate early-stage planning and site preparation activities.     Maintain a structured approach to ensure that the layout remains aligned with project requirements throughout the lifecycle, adapting as necessary.     Foster strong communication and collaboration within an international environment to prevent design clashes and ensure cohesive project execution.     Contribute to building a long-term engineering support capability that enhances our Layout Engineering team in Finspång. What You Bring     A University degree in Mechanical Engineering.     Several years of professional experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in gas turbines, power generation, or oil and gas sectors.     Demonstrated expertise in 3D CAD modeling (Siemens NX preferred) and PLM systems (ideally Teamcenter).     Strong technical skills in mechanical systems design, steel structure design, and project management.     Advanced English proficiency for effective intercultural communication and collaboration.     Attention to detail, structured working style, and excellent communication skills to engage with diverse teams and customers.     Willingness to learn about our products and engineering processes, with flexibility for business travel as needed. About the TeamThe team currently consist of 12 engineers from different parts of the world and with different backgrounds. We help each other to build a strong technical knowledge within the team and take joint responsibility to reach our goals. Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Application Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 305745 no later than 2026-12-06. Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date. We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers. Location: Finspång Trade Union Representatives:Unionen, unionen.finspang.se@siemens-energy.comSveriges Ingenjörer & SACO, asi.se@siemens-energy.comLedarna, ledarnaklubbenseab@siemens-energy.comIF Metall, Mikael Malmgren, mikael.malmgren@siemens-energy.com #page

title: HIL Testning
employer: Knightec Group Compliance and Management AB
description: Why this job is for you  Are you interested in developing the automotive industry and want to contribute to a collaborative and forward-thinking team? Have you experienced the challenges of working with embedded systems in organizations without well-defined or compliant software or hardware processes. If you’re interested in joining our team and our journey of building the next Center of Excellence within Functional Safety as well as other HIL and SIL functions in the automotive industry– this might be the challenge you’ve been looking for.In our Compliance & Management business area, we enable a smooth transition towards digital, sustainable, and secure solutions through our expertise in quality, safety, and leadership – while also helping to optimize production efficiency to strengthen profitabilityYour main tasks will be:    Develop, execute, and maintain test cases for Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments.    Perform functional and logical testing during early development phases.    Conduct realistic integration tests using actual hardware (HIL) to validate software behavior under real-world conditions.    Analyze and identify software issues related to hardware interaction, with a focus on compliance with Functional Safety standards.    Collaborate with developers, system engineers, and safety engineers to ensure test coverage meets safety and performance requirements.    Contribute to the development of test strategies and frameworks that align with automotive industry best practices.Your qualifications:    Engineering degree related technical field with strong knowledge in ISO26262    Solid understanding of embedded systems development and real-time software.    Hands-on experience in Software-in-the-loop (SIL) and/or Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test environments.    Familiarity with test automation frameworks, scripting (e.g. Python, CAPL, or similar), and simulation tools such as dSPACE, Vector, VT System, CANoe, CANape, and Simulink.    Must have good knowledge in System Viewer (SE-TOOL)    Preferably knowledge of Functional Safety standards, particularly ISO 26262, and how they apply to software testing, hardware testing, validation, verification and documentation of and test protocols. Preferably in the automotive- or any other safety-critical industry.    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to diagnose complex system interactions between software and hardware.Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams Ready to Make an Impact and Build a Career to be Proud of:Functional Safety is a multidisciplinary domain contributing to developing safer electronic products for our society. It has become increasingly crucial in our digital age as the growing trends in automation, connectivity, and electromobility have heightened our reliance on vulnerable cyber-physical systems.You will be given the opportunity to be part of our Functional Safety team, working together with competence development and client projects. Together, you will form cross-functional teams, working on Functional Safety-related projects for our clients. In the team, we support each other and share and develop knowledge together. The clients are within the automotive industry, both OEM’s and sub suppliers. There will be a variety of projects and competence initiatives during your career at Knightec.Besides from playing a crucial role in shaping the initiative’s future. You will be given great flexibility in forming your role and focusing on the aspects that you find most interesting. Competence devolvement will be given to you - Your ambition will lead the way; we will provide you with the tools and conditions required to achieve your goals. You will have a personal development plan, and we will help you build your career through close collaboration and teamwork. Allowing you to learn and work with some of the most skilled professionals in the industry. Practical information This is a permanent position with a six-month probationary period, based at our office inLindholmsallen 2 Gothenburg. Business travel to our clients may be required. The start date is as soon as possible or as agreed upon.Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-12-14. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Oliver Rydberg, Talent Acquisition Specialist. Please note that, due to GDPR, we only accept applications via our career page.We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Rehabilitation Medicine Career Opportunity in a Unique Nordic Archipelago
description: Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!Are you a rehabilitation medicine specialist seeking a fulfilling career in a peaceful and inspiring environment?A small hospital located in a scenic archipelago is now looking for a specialist in rehabilitation medicine to join its dedicated and multidisciplinary team. This is a unique opportunity to practice meaningful, patient-centered care while enjoying a balanced and nature-connected lifestyle.About the roleAs a rehabilitation medicine specialist, you will work with the assessment, treatment, and follow-up of patients with various physical disabilities, often resulting from neurological conditions, musculoskeletal injuries, or chronic pain. You will collaborate closely with physiotherapists, occupational therapists, nurses, and other specialists.The position offers both inpatient and outpatient work and allows you to tailor parts of your role to your own clinical interests. There are also opportunities to contribute to the development of rehabilitation services within the department.    Working hours: 38.5 hours/week    Salary: Competitive, individually negotiatedRequirements:    Holds an EU-recognized specialist certification in rehabilitation medicine    Has at least 2 years of experience as a specialist    Broad clinical experience with neurorehabilitation, musculoskeletal injuries or chronic pain management    Comfortable working both independently and within a multidisciplinary team    Interested in contributing to the ongoing development of services and patient careAbout the locationThis Nordic island community, with around 30,000 residents, offers clean air, a peaceful pace of life, and endless opportunities for outdoor activities such as sailing, cycling, swimming, fishing, and golf. Families will appreciate the excellent schools, daycare options, and safe, supportive environment. The community is welcoming and offers opportunities for partners to find meaningful work as well.What Dignus Medical offers you:    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment    Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required    Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family    Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/SkypeTake the next step in your career – and a big step toward a more balanced life.You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: Advance Your Career as a Radiologist in Sweden
description: Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!Radiologists career opportunities across SwedenSweden currently has a strong need for specialist radiologists within both general diagnostic radiology and several subspecialties. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, radiologists from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within the Swedish healthcare system.We collaborate with hospitals and imaging departments across Sweden, ranging from regional hospitals to large university hospitals. Our goal is to match your professional background, experience and preferences with the right workplace.Radiologists in Sweden play a central role in clinical decision-making and work in close collaboration with physicians from many specialties. The work is primarily clinically focused and supported by modern imaging technology, digital reporting systems and well-structured workflows. Departments typically operate advanced diagnostic equipment including MRI, CT, ultrasound and conventional radiography, supported by modern PACS systems.Professional DevelopmentThe current need in Sweden is primarily for radiologists who wish to focus on clinical diagnostic work. Radiologists often work broadly within diagnostic radiology while gradually developing subspecialist expertise depending on their interests and the needs of the department. Multidisciplinary collaboration with clinicians is an important part of everyday work.For those interested, opportunities for teaching, research collaboration and academic involvement may also be available, particularly within larger hospitals. Some radiologists later choose to combine clinical work with teleradiology as part of their career development.Relocation and SupportRelocating to another country is a significant step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process, from identifying suitable positions to becoming established in Sweden.You will have an advisor guiding you through each step, including assistance with medical licensing, relocation planning and practical matters related to moving. Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.Your advisor will remain your main point of contact throughout the entire process, from the initial discussions until you are fully established in your new role and life in Sweden.Support for your familyMany physicians relocate with their families, and we provide guidance to help make the transition as smooth as possible. This may include information about schools, childcare and everyday life in Sweden, as well as guidance for partners seeking employment. If your partner works within healthcare, there may also be opportunities within our network.Language trainingTo work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required. Dignus Medical provides intensive Swedish language training with professional instructors, online and adapted to your schedule.Language training can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children up to B2 level to support their integration into Swedish society.Living in SwedenSweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and well-developed public services. Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for leisure activities.Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children. The country’s forests, lakes and coastline also provide excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year.RequirementsWe are seeking radiologists who hold EU-recognized specialist certification in radiology, have good communication skills in English and are motivated to learn Swedish.Interested?Radiologists working in general diagnostic radiology as well as those with subspecialist expertise are welcome to explore opportunities with us.Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.We look forward to receiving your application!You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: Digital Project Manager
description: We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started.At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future - and we want you to be part of it.As a Digital Project Manager, you will join a team that delivers digital solutions across multiple customer touchpoints using agile, value-driven development in a close collaboration with different stakeholders. By bridging business stakeholders, customer experience, and cross-functional teams, this role reduces fragmentation, increases alignment, and accelerates value delivery. It provides a single point of accountability for initiatives from discovery to optimization, ensuring that learning, prioritization, and execution are guided by customer insight, data, and strategic intent. You will report to Katja Eriksson, Optimization & Governance Manager.About the role:In this role, you will lead digital initiatives end-to-end, from early idea exploration and discovery through launch and continuous optimization. You will coordinate and collaborate closely with customer experience (CX) teams, development, marketing, and external stakeholders to ensure seamless execution. A key part of your work will be to ensure that all initiatives are grounded in data, insights, and real customer needs.Transparency is central to how we work - you will create clear visibility into progress, decisions, and priorities for all stakeholders. Documentation is also an essential part of the role, ensuring that learning, requirements, and processes are captured and shared in a structured and accessible way.You will follow up on goals, create transparency, and support prioritization through agile ways of working. Acting as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, you will keep the overall picture together and ensure alignment across the organization and external parties.About you:You’re proactive, pragmatic, and collaborative - prestige‑less, curious about the digital landscape, and comfortable driving change across diverse stakeholders. You ask for help when needed to move the work forward.Your skills and background:    Relevant education in UX or digital marketing, or equivalent professional experience    Several years of experience in agile project management    Strong stakeholder management skills    Digital savvy, with hands-on experience using data and insights to guide initiatives and decisions    Ability to work with high transparency and maintain clear, structured documentation throughout the entire project life cycle.    Experience from agency/consultancy is considered a plus but not a requirement    Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written LocationThis position will be based in Huskvarna, Sweden. We believe in a dynamic, energized workplace and day-to-day collaboration, and we meet in the office at least 4 days a week (80%). Your application:Please submit your application in English as soon as possible as we will review applications on an ongoing basis. description: Make Nordic parcel logistics work better for customers and operations. Turn complex product needs into practical improvements.PostNord is developing its Nordic parcel portfolio to create customer value, support profitable growth and harmonise services across markets. As a Nordic Product Specialist, you will play an important role in making these improvements work in practice within your assigned product area. Using your product expertise and understanding of logistics operations, you will help improve products, streamline launches and simplify everyday work.The role will focus on either C2C/Recommerce or International & Customs, including international parcel flows, import and export. Responsibilities will be adapted to the assigned product area, customer journeys and operational needs.Your main responsibilities include:    Build expertise in product logic, services, terms, customer needs and logistics processes.    Support Product Managers with insights for roadmaps, lifecycle decisions, portfolio optimisation and product improvements.     Maintain clear product specifications, rules, terms input, operational requirements and documentation.    Translate operational needs into system requirements in close collaboration with IT and Operations.    Ensure accurate, consistent product data across systems and channels, and make product knowledge accessible to stakeholders.    Support launches, changes, migrations and phase-outs through readiness checks, implementation follow-up, issue resolution and hypercare.    Coordinate implementation across Operations, IT, Customer Service, Commercial, Legal, CX, Pricing and Nordic markets.    Share product knowledge through guidance, internal communication and change support.    Capture and escalate local needs, implementation issues and post-launch feedback to support Nordic product development and prioritisation.The Bigger PictureThe position is part of PostNord´s Nordic product organisation, where operational understanding and collaboration across different functions are essential to improving parcel services.The Nordic Product Specialist reports to the relevant Manager Solutions Area and works closely with Product Managers and colleagues across functions and Nordic markets. The role provides insight into how logistics processes, systems and customer needs connect across the Nordic network.The position can be based at one of PostNord´s main offices in Solna, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen. A hybrid working model applies, with three days per week at the office. Some travel within the Nordics is expected, particularly when building relationships and gaining a deeper understanding of operations. Our ExpectationsThe role is suited to someone who is curious, business minded and practical in their approach, combining product expertise with analytical thinking and attention to detail. The ability to challenge unclear logic, simplify complexity and connect people across Nordic markets is important. Taking ownership and following through until changes work in practice will be key to succeeding in the position.Relevant experience from logistics, preferably parcel logistics, or from a role involving operational logistics flows and process improvements is important. Suitable backgrounds may include product management, operations, customer service, sales support, process development or a comparable area.Relevant skills and experience include:    Understanding of logistics operations, operational processes and how parcel flows connect with systems and services.    Ability to structure complex product information, documentation, requirements and master data.    Understanding of how products, operations, systems, channels and market implementation connect.    Analytical, solution oriented thinking that turns product knowledge into practical improvements.    Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills to move work forward across functions.    Good working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint, including the ability to analyse information and present findings clearly.    Fluency in spoken and written English and at least one of the following languages: Swedish, Danish, Norwegian or Finnish. Experience from a Nordic or matrix organisation, product launches, migrations or change initiatives involving different functions is an advantage. Relevant experience within international logistics and customs, or C2C/Recommerce, is also valuable depending on the assigned product area. A university or college degree is an advantage but not a requirement. Interested?We work with TNG in this recruitment process. If you are interested in this position, apply right now! title: PhD position in Agricultural Science
description: Department of Biosystems and TechnologyThird-cycle subject area: Agricultural SciencePhD Project: Sustainability Assessment of Agroecological Farming SystemsDescription of the doctoral projectThe PhD project is a collaboration between the Animal Centred Environments group and the Horticultural and Agroecological Systems (HAS) subject area within the Department. The doctoral research will focus on sustainability assessment of agroecological livestock farming systems, drawing on expertise across both groups and involving collaboration with researchers, farmers and other stakeholders across Europe and Africa through ALASTRA and STRONG MCSA.About the positionHow can sustainability assessment support the transition to more resilient and sustainable farming systems? This PhD project will investigate how multi-criteria approaches can capture the environmental, economic and social performance of agroecological farming systems, identify synergies and trade-offs, and support decisions by farmers and other agricultural stakeholders.The doctoral student will work primarily within ALASTRA (Agroecology Living Labs in Africa: Redefining the Role of Animals in Food Systems for Climate Action and Sustainability), an EU-funded Horizon Europe project. ALASTRA brings together researchers, farmers and other stakeholders to co-design and evaluate agroecological livestock farming practices through living labs in Kenya, Tanzania, Tunisia and Zambia. SLU leads the development of the holistic assessment framework, including the selection of indicators and the design of sampling and data collection protocols.The doctoral student will contribute to developing, adapting and evaluating this framework. The research will draw on approaches such as the Global Farm Metric and established agroecological assessment tools, including OASISm the PG tool and TAPE.The doctoral student will also contribute to STRONG MCSA, an EU-funded Erasmus+ project that strengthens agricultural stakeholders’ capacity to use multi-criteria sustainability assessment (MCSA). These activities will provide a complementary foundation for the doctoral research in ALASTRA.The doctoral project will combine literature-based research, development and evaluation of assessment methods, quantitative and qualitative data analysis, and engagement with farmers, advisors and researchers. The student will collaborate with partners in Europe and Africa, contribute to project workshops and scientific publications, and communicate findings to academic and practitioner audiences. International visits and participation in project activities may form part of the doctoral studies.RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).The following specific entry requirements apply: For the subject of agricultural science, the applicant must have the equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in relevant subject areas. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.Your profileRequired qualifications    A Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Agroecology, Agricultural Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability Science, or a related field    A good understanding of agricultural systems, agroecology and sustainability challenges    Experience in research methods and quantitative data analysis, demonstrated through a degree project or equivalent work    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken    Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an international, multidisciplinary teamDesirable qualifications    Knowledge or experience of Multi Criteria Sustainability Assessment (MCSA), Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), indicator development or farm assessment tools    Experience with literature reviews and the comparative analysis of methods or tools    Experience with statistical analysis and software such as R, or with qualitative research methods    Knowledge of livestock farming, grazing systems, soil health or agroecological transitions    Experience collaborating with farmers, advisors or other agricultural stakeholders, including participatory research or workshops    Experience working in African agricultural contexts or other international research settings    Interest or experience in developing training resources and communicating research to practitioners    Good communication skills in Swedish or another Scandinavian language    A valid car driver’s licence recognized in SwedenAbout usAt the Department of Biosystems and Technology, we explore interactions between soil, plants, animals, the environment, climate, and humans in systems for sustainable food production and renewable raw materials.More information about the department on title: Business Performance Manager to BA Biomaterials

Proficiency in Swedish or Finnish is considered a strong advantage. About the companyStora Enso ABStora Enso is a global leader in renewable materials with a strong focus onpackaging. title: Finance & Compliance Operations Specialist

title: Master Thesis in Industrial design
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description: Do you want to help us speed up the shift towards a more sustainable mining and construction industry? By doing your thesis in collaboration with Epiroc you will get the chance to be a part of this journey. You will work together with experienced and helpful colleagues in an atmosphere characterized by creativity, innovation, and workplace diversity. In your specific project you have the chance to be a part of a challenging and educational experience while growing both professionally and personally. Available Thesis Topics ⚡ Electrification How can future mining and construction sites transition to electric operations? Explore solutions for charging, energy supply, and infrastructure that enable a safe and efficient shift from fossil-fuel-powered equipment to electrified machines. 🤖 Automation UX - Human & Autonomous Systems How will people collaborate with autonomous systems in the future? Explore user experiences and interface concepts that create trust, control, and effective collaboration between operators and automated solutions. 🎮 Automation UX - Remote Operations How can we create a stronger sense of presence when operating equipment remotely? Investigate new ways of designing user interfaces that support productivity, situational awareness, and decision-making from a distance. ⛏️ Autonomous Mine - Zero Humans What would a fully autonomous mine look like? Analyze the technologies, processes, and infrastructure needed to enable mining operations with little or no human presence underground. 🌱 Sustainability & Circular Solutions How can Epiroc contribute to a more sustainable future? Explore products, services, and business opportunities that support recycling, resource efficiency, and circular material flows. 🏗️ Future Infrastructure What new business opportunities could shape Epiroc's future? Identify emerging needs within infrastructure, construction, urban development, and recycling, and propose innovative products, services, or business models. 🚀 Space Mining How could mining be performed beyond Earth? Explore concepts for mineral exploration, extraction, and maintenance in extreme environments where human presence is limited or impossible. 💡 Open Topic Have an idea of your own? Propose a thesis topic related to mining, infrastructure, sustainability, or future technologies, and develop it together with our team into a project that creates value for the industry of tomorrow. Mission: The deliverables shall be a presentation explaining the thoughts behind the proposed solutions, the work process and a scaled model. The measurement will be done by the mentors appointed for the project. The exact task for the project will be set by you and your appointed mentors. Qualification: To be successful in this project you need to have an open mind for different possible solutions. You shall also Dare-To-Think-New. Challenge established conventions in the mining industry. Education background: Master Thesis student in Industrial Design Level of thesis project: Master Thesis. Functional area: Industrial Design Recruiting manager: Bengt Parkedal, Head of Industrial Design Phone: +46(0) 10 755 16 32, 0720-832 632 Email: bengt.parkedal@epiroc.com Other contacts: Anders Sandström, Experienced Designer. Number of students in the project: One or two students/project. How to apply: Does this sound interesting, and do you feel this is a match? Log in to the recruitment system. If you are new to the system, you need to start by making a profile. Do not forget to attach your CV, Portfolio and a short letter about your-self, describing why you are applying for this thesis and, make a pitch for your project according to the topic for the master thesis. In this process, we review applications continuously and the project can be completed before last day of application. We recommend sending your application as soon possible, but no later than December 05. Please note that we do not accept applications via email

environments and are motivated by building smart, automated solutions.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions title: QA Supplier Quality Specialist
description: At Galderma, we advance dermatology for every skin story through science, innovation, and strong partnerships. We are now looking for a QA Supplier Quality Specialist to join our Supplier Control team in Uppsala. This is a highly visible role where you will work closely with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and internal stakeholders across the organization to ensure compliance, quality, and continuous improvement throughout our supply chain.You will represent Galderma in supplier audits and quality discussions, acting as a trusted quality partner while contributing to the development of our supplier quality processes.If you enjoy building relationships, driving quality excellence, and taking ownership of complex supplier-related quality activities in a global and regulated environment, this could be the right opportunity for you. Your teamYou will join Galderma's Supplier Quality team, a collaborative and highly engaged group within Quality Assurance. The team plays a critical role in ensuring that suppliers, service providers, and contract manufacturers consistently meet Galderma's quality and compliance expectations.Working closely with colleagues across QA, Procurement, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T), Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Regulatory Affairs, you will contribute to building a robust supplier network that supports both operational excellence and patient safety. Your missionAs QA Supplier Quality Specialist, your mission is to ensure that Galderma's suppliers and external partners operate in compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements. Through proactive supplier oversight, audits, quality agreements, and continuous improvement initiatives, you will help safeguard product quality throughout the supply chain.You will act as a trusted quality partner, representing Galderma in supplier interactions and helping to strengthen the quality culture both internally and externally. Key Responsibilities    Manage supplier qualification, supplier control, and supplier lifecycle activities.    Plan, conduct, and follow up quality audits of suppliers, service providers, and contract manufacturers.    Represent Galderma during supplier audits and quality reviews.    Act as a key point of contact for supplier quality-related questions and support suppliers in meeting Galderma's quality expectations.    Analyze audit outcomes, identify compliance gaps related to GMP and GDP requirements, and ensure timely follow-up of observations and corrective actions.    Review and manage supplier change notifications and assess potential quality impacts.    Investigate and manage deviations related to materials and external services.    Establish, maintain, and update quality agreements with suppliers and business partners.    Drive continuous improvements within supplier quality processes and programs.    Collaborate closely with Procurement, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T), Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and other Quality functions to ensure robust supplier oversight.    Build strong and sustainable relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. Your profileWe are looking for an experienced Quality Assurance professional who enjoys working in a role with a high degree of responsibility, autonomy, and external exposure. As a trusted representative of Galderma, you will interact closely with suppliers and partners, lead quality discussions, and contribute to building strong and sustainable supplier relationships.You are comfortable taking ownership of complex quality matters, investigating issues, and driving activities through to completion. At the same time, you understand the importance of collaboration and are able to build strong relationships across functions, cultures, and organizational levels.To succeed in this role, you are a proactive and self-driven professional who combines a structured and analytical approach with sound judgement and a continuous improvement mindset. You thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy identifying opportunities for improvement, and are motivated by delivering high-quality results. Required Qualifications· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmacy, Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality Management, or another relevant field.· Several years of experience working within a GMP-regulated environment.· Experience from the pharmaceutical industry.· Professional proficiency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.· Strong knowledge of quality systems and regulatory requirements.· Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and drive activities to completion.· Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.Preferred Qualifications    Experience planning, conducting, and following up supplier audits.    Experience representing a company during external audits and supplier quality reviews.    Experience with supplier qualification programs and supplier lifecycle management.    Experience from Quality Assurance. Location and informationThis position is based onsite in Uppsala, Sweden. The role includes regular travel within Europe to supplier sites and business partners. We review applications on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Why GaldermaAt Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio

title: Mechanical Development Engineer - Electrical Integration Focus
description: A Snapshot of Your DayJoin our open-minded team where collaboration and support are at the heart of what we do! electrical experts.How You’ll Make an Impact    Design structural and layout solutions for gas turbine packages while producing manufacturing data and technical documentation in Siemens NX.    Develop and maintain 3D layouts, installation concepts, and design documentation for package structures and equipment arrangements.    Drive the integration of electrical installations within the package layout, including junction boxes, cable routing, cable trays, conduits, and installation supports.    Collaborate closely with Electrical Engineering to ensure electrical solutions are efficiently incorporated into the overall product design.    Participate in the development and maintenance of product standards, design guidelines, and best practices within Structure & Layout and electrical integration.    Work with procurement, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams to develop robust, cost-effective, and manufacturable technical solutions.    Support development projects and customer orders by delivering high-quality designs that meet project requirements, schedules, and quality expectations.    Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, focusing on electrical routing methodologies, NX design processes, and installation concepts.What You Bring    A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.    Proficiency in Siemens NX for design and documentation.    Experience in structural design and layout, particularly in the context of gas turbine packages.    Relevant knowledge of electrical systems, including familiarity with electrical integration concepts and installation practices.    Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.    A commitment to delivering high-quality designs that meet project requirements.    Advanced English proficiency is required.About the TeamThe Structure & Layout team consists of 19 skilled engineers specializing in structural engineering and layout design for Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.Who is Siemens Energy?At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to DiversityLucky for us, we are not all the same. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.ApplicationDon’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 307247 not later than 2026-12-09.Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.Location: FinspångTrade Union Representatives:Unionen, unionen.finspang.se@siemens-energy.comSveriges Ingenjörer & SACO, asi.se@siemens-energy.comLedarna, Anders Fors, ledarnaklubbenseab@siemens-energy.comIF Metall, Mikael Malmgren, mikael.malmgren@siemens-energy.com#LI-MN1

title: Scientist (temp cover)
description: Scientist (temp cover)Analytical Chemistry and HPLCNordic BioAnalysis AB | Södertälje, SwedenAre you an experienced analytical scientist with strong hands-on HPLC expertise? Established in 2010 and based in Södertälje, we provide chemical, biochemical, microbiological and molecular biological analysis of materials and products, from development through to commercialisation.Our international team brings together experienced scientists, technicians and project managers committed to quality, scientific integrity and responsive customer service.About the roleWe are looking for a Senior Scientist with at least five years of hands-on analytical laboratory experience in a GMP and/or ISO-regulated environment, with a strong focus on HPLC.This is a practical laboratory role with substantial responsibility for HPLC method development, transfer, validation, troubleshooting and routine analysis. and ideas can influence laboratory practices and the company’s development.Your responsibilities·      Develop and optimise HPLC methods, including sample preparation, separation conditions, detection and system suitability.·      Plan, execute and document analytical method transfers, validation and verification studies.·      Perform routine HPLC analysis of raw materials, active substances and finished products to support quality control, release testing and stability studies.·      Investigate chromatographic issues, including poor separation, retention-time shifts, peak shape, carryover and inconsistent results.·      Perform routine analysis such as TOC, Water content with KF and other wet chemistry analysis.·      Evaluate analytical data, interpret results and prepare clear protocols, reports and laboratory records with full traceability.·      Contribute to laboratory investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective actions in collaboration with quality colleagues.·      Take responsibility for assigned instruments, including maintenance, calibration and qualification activities.·      Provide technical guidance and share knowledge with colleagues.·      Collaborate with project and quality teams to deliver accurate results within agreed timelines.Your experience and qualificationsEssential·      At least five years of hands-on experience in an analytical laboratory operating under GMP and/or an ISO laboratory quality system, particularly ISO/IEC 17025.·      Extensive practical HPLC and GC experience, with demonstrated ability to develop, transfer, validate and troubleshoot methods, as well as perform routine analysis.·      A university degree in chemistry, analytical chemistry, biochemistry, pharmaceutical sciences or a closely related discipline.·      Strong understanding of laboratory documentation, data integrity, traceability and working to approved procedures.·      The ability to plan and perform laboratory work independently, assess results critically and solve analytical problems.·      Full professional proficiency in English.An advantage·      Experience with HPLC-UV and HPLC-RI.·      Experience with reversed-phase, size-exclusion or ion-exchange chromatography.·      Experience with pharmacopoeial methods and pharmaceutical or medical device testing.·      Additional skills in Karl Fischer titration, TOC, IR, UV/Vis or wet chemistry.·      Experience mentoring colleagues or coordinating analytical projects.·      Knowledge of Swedish.Who you areYou are structured, curious and thorough, with a practical approach to problem-solving. title: Senior Software Engineer - AI-Assisted Legacy Modernisation
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description: Job ID: 6886We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Black Ops unit on a full-time, permanent basis. This is the right role for you if you enjoy understanding complex legacy applications and using AI-assisted engineering to modernize them for strategically supported platforms. You combine hands-on development skills with the analytical judgement to challenge AI-generated changes, verify that application behaviour is preserved and deliver maintainable, production-ready software. Ideally, you will also help develop our framework for grounding and constraining AI-generated changes to reduce hallucinations and unsupported assumptions.About our teamMeet the Black Ops team. We support the internal customers and engineers working with Nordea’s Internal Developer Platform, helping teams resolve complex technical challenges when expectations meet reality. You will play a senior, hands-on role in using agentic AI to refactor legacy applications and help development teams adopt modern platforms and DevOps practices. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to the framework that makes our AI-assisted workflows more controlled, verifiable and reliable. In this role, your main responsibilities will be:    Analyse legacy applications, including Java systems, to understand their behaviour, dependencies and constraints before refactoring    Use AI-assisted and agentic development workflows to refactor legacy code for strategically supported platforms while preserving required functionality    Independently review AI-generated changes, challenge unsupported assumptions and verify correctness through code analysis and automated testing    Build and strengthen regression tests to validate application behaviour before and after refactoring    Build and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines that integrate AI-assisted development with automated builds, testing and deployment    Support the rollout of our agentic AI solution across development teams and help them adopt effective, responsible engineering practices    Provide feedback on AI-generated results and help improve the framework’s context grounding, constraints and validation checks to reduce hallucinations and unintended changes    Collaborate with application developers, architects and platform teams to resolve complex modernisation challenges and reduce legacy dependencies    Develop DevOps practices within Service Domains and help teams become independent in building, deploying and operating modernised applications    Ensure refactored applications meet Nordea Quality Standards, including security, maintainability and operational readinessWe follow hybrid model of working (up to 40 % remote). This role is open in Poland (Tri-city or Warsaw), Finland (Helsinki), Sweden (Stockholm), Denmark (Taastrup), or Norway (Oslo). We offer employment with various benefits based on your location, which may include private health and life insurance, learning opportunities, holiday subsidies, bonuses and more.Who you areYou are an experienced engineer who combines strong software development skills with curiosity, initiative and sound technical judgement. You see AI as an engineering tool, not a substitute for understanding the system or taking responsibility for the result. You are confident but humble, solution-driven and comfortable questioning generated code. You understand that software quality goes beyond code quality to include correct behaviour, security, reliable delivery and operability. You enjoy helping others adopt new tools and ways of working.This is the right role for you if you:    Have a solid system engineering and development background    Are comfortable reading unfamiliar legacy code and validating AI-generated changes against application requirements    Have practical experience moving legacy applications or code to modern cloud environments    Stay one step ahead by identifying technical risks, dependencies and improvement opportunities    Are comfortable switching between hands-on engineering, troubleshooting and stakeholder discussions    Can stand your ground when needed while remaining open to different perspectives    Communicate and pitch technical solutions clearly to Service Domain leads and engineering teams    Enjoy guiding and mentoring others through technical and organisational changeYour background and skills include:    Strong hands-on Java development experience, including Spring and Spring Boot, and the ability to understand and refactor legacy applications; familiarity with Node.js    Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, with the ability to critically review generated code and verify changes through unit, integration and regression testing    Experience building CI/CD pipelines using Git/Bitbucket and tools such as Tekton, Argo CD or Jenkins, together with infrastructure automation using Terraform or Ansible    Strong Linux and Windows system administration and troubleshooting skills, with experience operating systems in virtualised, cloud or containerised environments    A solid understanding of Google Cloud Platform and how to deploy, operate and modernise applications in a Google Cloud environment    Familiarity with container-based application architecture and infrastructure using Docker and KubernetesIt would be ideal if you also have:    Experience developing AI-assisted engineering frameworks or agentic workflows, including repository context grounding, constrained tool use, automated validation and human review to reduce hallucinations and unsupported changes     Experience with AWS    Knowledge of Groovy    Change management mindsetIf this sounds like you, get in touch!Next stepsSubmit your application no later than 02/12/2026. For more information about the position, you are more than welcome to contact recruiter Sanna Frisk at sanna.frisk@nordea.com.For union information, please contact finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACONordea@nordea.com.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
description: Do you have extensive experience recruiting senior and executive talent in global organizations? We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner who can independently lead complex recruitment processes, advise senior stakeholders and turn market insight into effective hiring strategies.About the jobThis is a full-time consulting assignment where you will cover a parental leave. You will either be employed by Bravura and work as a consultant at the company, or work as a subcontractor through Bravura.The assignment is expected to start in December 2026 and run through November 2027, with some flexibility regarding the start date.About the companyThe company is a global organization with headquarters in Stockholm, operating across multiple international markets. You will join a global Talent Acquisition function and work closely with colleagues across Europe as well as other international markets.The environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative, with a strong emphasis on transparency and individual ownership. You will use data and market insights to improve candidate journeys and ways of working, while maintaining accurate candidate pipelines, feedback and recruitment records in the ATS.Education, experience and personal characteristics    At least 8 years of hands-on experience within sourcing and recruitment, including corporate and commercial positions    Proven experience recruiting senior leadership and executive-level positions    Experience partnering and advising directly with senior leaders and C-suite stakeholders throughout recruitment processes    Previous recruitment experience from a global, fast-paced organization    Full professional fluency in English, both written and spokenIt is also meritorious if you have:    Experience working with Teamtailor and LinkedIn Recruiter    Experience using market intelligence or talent mapping tools, such as LinkedIn Talent Insights or TalentNeuron    Professional proficiency in SwedishTo succeed in this role, you are comfortable taking full ownership of your recruitment processes and moving work forward without requiring detailed direction. title: IPR Coordinator
description: Do you enjoy precise, well-organized work, and are you curious about how innovations are protected?Are you curious about technology, innovation, and how groundbreaking ideas are protected? Join our global IPR team as an IPR Coordinator and become a key part of the journey from invention disclosure to granted patents around the world. In this role, you will work at the intersection of technology, intellectual property, and international collaboration, connecting inventors, patent engineers, R&D, Legal teams, and external patent agents. You will help ensure that valuable innovations are captured, protected, and managed efficiently while contributing to process development and data quality within a global organization. This role offers flexibility in location and can be based at one of our main offices in Sweden or Finland, with a preference for Karlstad in Sweden. Your responsibilities     You will coordinate invention disclosures, register new matters in our IP management system, and work closely with inventors, patent engineers, and R&D teams throughout the innovation process.     You will manage patent, trademark, utility model, and design filings by collaborating with inventors, external patent agents, and international stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met.     You will maintain and develop our patent portfolio, monitor deadlines, coordinate office actions, and help secure high-quality intellectual property protection worldwide.     You will support competitor monitoring activities and perform searches in international patent databases to help provide valuable patent information.     You will manage IPR-related documentation, agreements, invoices, reporting, and data quality while supporting continuous improvements within the IPR function. Expectations for you     You have a relevant post-secondary education and/or experience in administration, coordination, or a similar role.     You have experience from IPR, legal services, or technology-intensive environments, or a strong motivation to develop expertise within intellectual property.     You are comfortable working with digital systems, data management, reporting, and process improvement activities.     You have strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.     You have advanced written and spoken Swedish and English proficiency. To succeed in this role Success in this position requires organizational skills, a structured way of working, and a strong commitment to meeting deadlines. You are comfortable coordinating stakeholders simultaneously and enjoy working in an international environment where accuracy and collaboration are essential. Your curiosity about technology and intellectual property, combined with a service-minded approach and strong digital skills, will help you create value across the organization. We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:     Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through     Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly     Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety     Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value We offer You will join a global IPR function that works closely with R&D, Legal, and business teams across multiple countries. You will gain hands-on insight into the world of patents, trademarks, and innovation protection while working alongside experienced colleagues who are eager to share their knowledge. The role provides opportunities to develop your IPR expertise, improve processes and systems, and contribute to how intellectual property is managed globally. At Valmet, you will find an inspiring and collaborative work environment where innovation and sustainability go hand in hand. We support your professional development through learning opportunities, flexible working arrangements, and competitive employee benefits. You will work with modern tools, international colleagues, and meaningful technologies that help industries move toward a more sustainable future. Want to know more?
